raw.excerpt: DescriptionAI-Native Platform Engineer — DevOps, Security & Compliance, Mid to Senior | Zenara HealthLocation: Remote - India Type: Full-time Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time.
raw.description:
Description

AI-Native Platform Engineer — DevOps, Security & Compliance, Mid to Senior | Zenara Health

Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule.

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

About the Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. We work with sensitive healthcare data, so reliability, security, access control, backups, and compliance are not side concerns — they are part of the product ..

We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly, but we need to move with discipline because customers and patient data depend on us.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-Native Platform Engineer to own DevOps, production reliability, security operations, and compliance foundations.

This is not a narrow DevOps ticket role.

This is not a compliance paperwork role.

This is a hands-on platform ownership role.

Today, platform, security, and compliance work is spread across people who are already covering other responsibilities. We need one full-time owner who keeps systems running, backed up, updated, monitored, secure, and HIPAA-ready ..

You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and a part-time senior security and compliance consultant ..

Here is the test: can you prove that backups restore, deployments roll back, secrets are controlled, alerts work, access is locked down, and compliance evidence exists before a customer asks for it?

We are looking for a calm, methodical operator who automates the boring things, finds the scary things, and closes the important gaps.

Our Platform Vision

We are building an AI-native healthcare software company. That means our platform must support speed without creating unacceptable risk.

The platform should make the safe path the easy path: reliable deployments, observable systems, tested recovery, controlled access, documented evidence, automated checks, and continuous security awareness.

You will help build this operating system, including:

  • Deployment and rollback workflows
  • Monitoring and alerting
  • Backups and restore verification
  • Secrets and access management
  • Cloud configuration reviews
  • Security checks on new code and infrastructure
  • HIPAA compliance evidence
  • Vendor and AI-tool risk tracking
  • Daily automated security and compliance checks
  • Incident response basics
  • Platform documentation and runbooks

The goal is to create a platform that lets a small engineering team move fast without gambling with production or patient data.

What You’ll Do

  • Own production platform operations: deployments, monitoring, alerts, updates, and reliability.
  • Own backups and regularly prove restores work .
  • Manage access control, secrets, cloud configuration, and security checks.
  • Organize HIPAA-related policies, controls, audit evidence, and customer security documentation .
  • Identify, prioritize, and close platform and security gaps.
  • Build a daily security and compliance agent that sweeps systems and reports findings .
  • Work weekly with a senior security and compliance consultant.
  • Create runbooks, checklists, and automation for repeatable operational work.
  • Support incident response, recovery, and prevention.
  • Help free other team members from ad hoc platform and security work.

What We’re Looking For

  • Hands-on experience keeping startup systems and platforms running.
  • Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring, backups, and recovery experience.
  • Experience with access control, secrets management, cloud configuration, and security basics.
  • Ability to prove backups restore and systems recover.
  • Ability to code and automate routine platform or security tasks.
  • Comfort using AI agents to build automation and operational workflows.
  • Calm judgment during incidents and production issues.
  • Strong ownership and documentation habits.
  • Practical mindset: you can prioritize risks rather than create endless theoretical lists.

Our Current Stack

  • Azure AKS / Kubernetes
  • Azure Blob Storage
  • Azure Monitor / OpenTelemetry
  • Terraform
  • Helm
  • CI pipelines
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • Some AWS
  • TypeScript applications using Node.js / Hono and React
  • Medplum / FHIR
  • Healthcare data, HIPAA, patient-data protection, vendor risk, and AI-tool risk

What “AI-Native Platform Engineering” Means for This Role

For this role, being AI-native means you can:

  • Use agents to inspect configurations, draft runbooks, and automate checks.
  • Build recurring security and compliance sweeps.
  • Use AI to accelerate infrastructure review without blindly trusting it.
  • Create workflows that surface risks before humans remember to check.
  • Automate operational evidence gathering.
  • Maintain human approval for sensitive actions.
  • Keep permissions, secrets, and production access tightly controlled.
  • AI should help you create a more reliable platform, not become another unmanaged risk.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare or HIPAA experience.
  • Security background, such as cloud security, SOC, or incident response.
  • Compliance framework experience, especially HIPAA or SOC 2.
  • Azure and AKS production experience.
  • Kubernetes at production scale .

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will review the current setup, agree the top platform and security gaps, demonstrate a backup restore and deployment rollback, and produce a prioritized improvement list ..

Within your first 90 days, monitoring and alerting will be in place, top security gaps will be closed, the first version of the daily security/compliance agent will be running, and compliance evidence will be organized ..

Over time, success means Zenara has a reliable, secure, HIPAA-ready platform, clean customer security reviews, and platform work no longer depends on non-specialists.

Schedule

Live collaboration requires overlap with the US team. For engineering roles, the current collaboration window is approximately 6:00 PM to 12:00 AM IST, though final expectations should be confirmed during the hiring process.

Production incidents and critical deployments may occasionally require availability outside normal collaboration windows.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated ability and experience
  • Fully remote work
  • Equipment allowance
  • Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
  • Support from a senior security expert

Who Will Thrive in This Role

This role is well suited to someone who:

  • Is calm, methodical, and reliable.
  • Likes automating operational work.
  • Cares about security but can still move pragmatically.
  • Wants broad ownership across DevOps, security, and compliance.
  • Can operate independently without a large platform team.
  • Understands that healthcare data requires discipline.

You may struggle if you want a large ops team around you, only want one narrow specialty, treat compliance as paperwork only, cannot automate, or are careless with secrets and access.

If you want to build the operating foundation for an AI-native health-tech company, we would love to hear from you.

raw.description:
AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Job Details


Pharmacy Technicians in our Patient Care Center of Excellence may hold multiple duties to ensure ExactCare’s patients receive quality care out of their pharmacy services. They will work in a closed-door pharmacy environment, spending their time speaking with patients, doctors and facilities on the phone in addition to the outlined job duties and responsibilities.

Job duties will vary from phone work and navigating multiple pharmacy software systems to supporting the various stages of patient care/contact. These areas of responsibility will fluctuate based on organizational needs, allowing the Pharmacy Technician to develop multiple skillsets.


This is a remote-based environment, allowing the Pharmacy Technician to provide an exceptional patient experience. AnewHealth provides a fast-paced, high-energy environment, allowing Pharmacy Technicians to excel in many areas with a focus on phone-based pharmacy work.


Responsibilities

  • Providing an exceptional customer service experience each day in a phone-based environment.
  • Enter a high volume of data; processing prescription information with speed and accuracy.
  • Utilizing sound drug knowledge to effectively receive prescription authorizations, clarifications or transfers.
  • Perform claim adjudication and auditing duties such as prior authorizations, billing and eligibility checks. Requiring outbound calls to patients.
  • Working through current case queues to problem solve for patient care issues.
  • Serving as a liaison between the clinical pharmacists and other medical professionals on patients’ behalf.
  • Partner with technicians and pharmacists to ensure that new patients are successfully onboarded to ExactCare.
  • Maintaining patient records with strong attention to detail and confidentiality.
  • Accurate retrieval of all prescription information and verifying through doctor calls.
  • Placing welcome calls to newly onboarded patients and establish a trusted point of contact.
  • Placing outbound calls to patients to create, maintain or update their medication profiles.
  • Serve as backup support for times of higher patient call volume.
  • Effectively assist with patient questions over the phone.
  • Performing in a high volume, fast paced environment to support ExactCare’s nationwide patient base.
  • Embody AnewHealth’s Core Values in all communications and interactions.
  • Other duties as assigned.

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.

Qualifications: These represent the desired qualifications of the ideal candidate. They are not meant to limit consideration for candidates who do not meet all of the standards listed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education

  • High school diploma/GED
  • Certified with the Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) or the National Health Association (NHA) and maintain a current certificate
  • Must maintain a pharmacy technician registration with State Board of Pharmacy

Experience

  • Must be 18+ years of age
  • Prior experience in a pharmacy setting

Skills & Abilities

  • Comfortable working in a phone-based environment.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Self-motivated and goal oriented.
  • Ability to utilize computer equipment, technology and work within multiple software programs to receive medication authorizations, clarifications and/or transfers.
  • Exceptional customer service skills; servicing doctor’s office, pharmacist, and patient needs over the phone.
  • Thorough drug knowledge.
  • Pharmacy billing knowledge.
  • Knowledge of appropriate processes in taking prescriptions, clarifications and transfers including clear written and verbal communication.
  • Strong prioritization and organizational skills.
  • Maintain a high degree of confidentiality.
  • Passion to help people and enrich their lives.
  • Ability to think critically and document pertinent details in a world class manner that is compliant with state and federal regulations.

Physical/Mental Demands: This position is administrative in nature and will present physical demands requisite to a position requiring: hearing, seeing, sitting, standing, talking, and walking. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Must be able to commute to multiple site locations within assigned territory. May be necessary to work extended hours as needed.

Schedule: This is a full-time position with an expectation to work an average of 40 hours per week and be available outside of normal business hours to meet customer expectations on an ad-hoc basis. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

This is a remote position.

AnewHealth offers a comprehensive benefit package for full-time employees that includes medical/dental/vision, flexible spending, company-paid life insurance and short-term disability as well as voluntary benefits, 401(k), Paid Time Off and paid holidays. Medical, dental and vision coverage are effective 1st of the month following date of hire.

AnewHealth provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status, or other legally protected classification in the state in which a person is seeking employment. Applicants are encouraged to confidentially self-identify when applying. Local applicants are encouraged to apply. We maintain a drug-free work environment. Applicants must be eligible to work in this country.

We are looking for a Python Developer to join a team that develops an internal analytics platform and builds AI solutions to automate the work of analysts and data engineers.

You will work on backend services and analytics tools, integrate LLMs into existing products, and gradually take part in developing AI agents. This role is not only about AI development. It also includes regular backend tasks and working with frontend features.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and improve Python backend services for the internal analytics platform.
  • Build features for analytics tools, admin interfaces, and services for data engineers.
  • Integrate LLMs with databases, APIs, and analytics interfaces.
  • Take part in developing AI agents for data analysis, generating SQL from natural language requests (Text2SQL), and automating routine tasks.
  • Work on frontend features using React.
  • Design APIs and integrations, take part in architecture discussions, and help choose technical solutions.
  • Adapt open-source solutions to the platform's needs, write tests, and take part in code reviews.

Requirements

  • More than 3 years of commercial experience in Python backend development.
  • Experience with React or a willingness to learn it quickly.
  • Experience building backend services, APIs, and integrations between systems.
  • Knowledge of SQL and experience with relational databases, such as PostgreSQL.
  • Understanding of application architecture, design principles, and common development patterns.
  • Interest in LLMs and AI agents, understanding of the basic principles behind language models, and willingness to use them to solve practical problems.
  • Active use of AI tools in development and the ability to critically evaluate their results.
  • Ability to work independently, take a structured approach to solving problems, and learn existing codebases and new technologies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or using AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
  • Familiarity with vector databases such as pgvector, ChromaDB, or Qdrant.
  • Experience with analytical databases and data warehouses such as ClickHouse, Greenplum, or Vertica.
  • Familiarity with S3-compatible object storage, such as Ozone S3.
  • Experience building admin interfaces, internal tools, BI solutions, or analytics dashboards.
  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and service monitoring tools.
  • Experience adapting and extending open-source solutions.
  • English Proficiency: сonversational English at B1 level or above.

Benefits

  • Flexible schedules and opportunity to work remotely.
  • Ambitious and supportive team who love what they do, appreciate each other, and grow together.
  • Internal programs for adaptation and training, development of soft skills, and leadership abilities.
  • Partial compensation for participating in external training and conferences.
  • Corporate English school: Group and individual lessons, speaking clubs with colleagues from all over the world.
  • Corporate prices on hotels and travel services.
  • MyTime Day Off - an extra non-working day without loss of compensation.

They focus on driving mid-market sales and maintaining a high-level of client satisfaction. They are responsible for finding new business opportunities, engaging new clients or prospects, developing proposals, and handling the contract process. This role involves developing and implementing strategic sales initiatives to target and engage prospective clients, fostering strong relationships, and achieving sales targets. The Client Executive Director plays a crucial role in driving the company's expansion and ensuring client satisfaction.

Job Duties

  • Sell Argano’s Oracle Cloud solutions and consulting services directly into Public Sector accounts.
  • Strategically align with Oracle Channels and co-selling with their sales team
  • Maximize and expand Oracle network across public sector and solution engineering teams highlighting Argano’s team, capabilities, and tools.
  • Identify leads via targeted account lists, campaigns, networking, events and/or other sources.
  • Maximize professional network through trusted advisor and Executive relationships built by offering Argano services to said network.
  • Convert leads into qualified pipeline.
  • Understand industry trends and client needs, develop & deliver compelling value propositions.
  • Effectively lead a strategic and complex sales process
  • Work to achieve maximum sales profitability, growth, and account penetration directly or via the Oracle partner ecosystem.
  • Manage accounts throughout the entire sales process, and collaborate with team members in Marketing, Pre-sales, and Delivery to uncover customer needs.
  • Travel to customer sites to identify and develop sales opportunities.
  • Participate in the development, presentation, and sales of the Argano value proposition.
  • Give engaging customer presentations to all levels of leadership, including C-level.
  • Liaise with customer contacts for the purpose of managing customer relationships, identifying new opportunities, and maximizing sales.

Experience

  • 7+ years of Oracle Cloud Applications consulting services sales experience, with a focus on Public Sector is strongly preferred.
  • Experience selling cloud managed services, or similar solutions tied to enterprise application management and hosting a plus.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Professional certification as appropriate.
  • Excellent service-driven customer-focused skills.
  • Proven ability to work in both a team environment and independently.
  • Excellent oral, written and interpersonal communications skills.
  • Strong time management skills and attention to detail.
  • Requires thorough understanding of consultative sales, and the ability to build key relationships to become a trusted advisor to understand and solve customer problems.
  • Highly developed selling, customer relations and negotiations skills with the ability to effectively communicate with C-level executives and line of business representatives.
  • Must have high ethical standards and integrity, coupled with a desire to participate in growing our sales and support organization.
  • Must be able to manage a complex sales cycle and navigate the procurement organizations and processes.

Travel

This position requires up to 20% travel. Travel is frequently outside the local area and overnight.

Job Summary

Manage and provide the leadership of all areas associated with distributed energy resources (DERs) for the operating company. This could include, but is not limited to, development of strategic and tactical plans to meet operating company and department objectives, managing processes for distribution interconnections, coordination with other business unit functions on issues related to DERs, and other general functions that may impact DER programs, projects, and initiatives.Scope/Span of Control Requirement for Grade 10: Must have direct reports.

Job Description

What You'll Do:


  • Develop an alternative energy resource strategy for customer-owned and co-sourced project.
  • This would include determining the desired technologies to pursue and ensuring the anticipated results of programs and initiatives align with the Operating Company’s plans to meet the required Alternative Energy Resources Portfolio Standards.
  • Maintain continuous assessment of the strategy and make adjustments when appropriate. Take appropriate actions to ensure any renewable energy resources generating facilities are properly certified with the state’s Public Utility Commission.
  • Engage with other operating companies and corporate subject matter experts to evaluate and determine appropriate strategies for integrating DERs to the distribution system, which may include, but is not limited to: electric vehicles (EV), energy storage, demand response (DR), and renewables.
  • Evaluate relative economics across projects of various scale, locational benefit, technology attributes and performance characteristics. Additionally be engaged in regulatory and public policy in order to shape policy to align with strategies.
  • Prepare and conduct presentations, summaries, testimony and other communications necessary to support ongoing internal and external stakeholder outreach efforts. Stay abreast of current DER technologies to provide additional value to the operating company, our customers, and communities.
  • Continually assess the DER market conditions and use this intelligence to support recommendations on business plan developments. Lead and manage the DER interconnection process and team at the operating company. Manage non-customer Power Purchase Agreements.
  • This would include, but is not limited to, working with Commercial Operations to prepare a RFP and securing the PPA, oversight and administration of the PPA, preparing and securing an Interconnection Agreement, coordinating any construction of AEP facilities, and securing a standard electric service agreement, as needed.
  • Support regulatory filings associated with regulated renewables. Take a lead role in EV Charging Marketing & Customer Outreach including tariffs, incentives, etc.
  • Lead OPCO effort related to evaluation of Demand Reduction participation in SPP Markets as well as interface with third party aggregators. May serve as a resource to Customer Account Managers for electric service contract development.

What You'll Do:


Education requirements are listed below:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or engineering technology.

Work Experience requirement listed below:

  • Minimum of ten years of utility industry or applicable experience in an engineering, business development, regulatory, financial and/or business strategy role.
  • Minimum of three years in a leadership role. Registration as a Professional Engineer (PE) or Certified Energy Manager (CEM) is preferred.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:


  • Exhibits solid leadership and supervisory skills.
  • Strong technical knowledge of electric utility systems and distributed generation equipment.
  • Excellent analytical and time management skills.
  • Knowledgeable on state and national energy issues. Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Proven record of establishing constructive and strong relationships with customers, co-workers, trade allies, regulators, government representatives, utility industry associates, and others.

raw.description:
Associate Director, Product Management, UpToDate Core Experience & Access

The Role

Make the core UpToDate experience easy to access, use, and evolve for clinicians, care teams, and enterprise customers.

At Wolters Kluwer Health, the UpToDate suite supports millions of clinical decisions every day. As customer expectations, enterprise access models, clinical workflows, and digital product experiences continue to evolve, we are focused on delivering intuitive, reliable, and customer-ready experiences across core UpToDate web and mobile products.

As Associate Director, Product Management, UpToDate Core Experience & Access, you will own product strategy and execution for a meaningful area of the core UpToDate experience. This includes improving registration, login, access, identity, and entitlement experiences; advancing web and mobile product improvements; managing important customer, accessibility, operational, and roadmap priorities; and helping shape how the core UpToDate experience evolves over time.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a product leader who canoperateacross user experience, technical systems, enterprise customer needs, and product strategy. You will partner closely with engineering, UX, architecture, security, analytics, customer-facing, commercial, implementation, and product leadership teams to define priorities, make tradeoffs, and deliver measurable improvements for users and customers.

WhatYou’llDo

  • Own product strategy, roadmap priorities, and measurable outcomes for core UpToDate experience and access-related capabilities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of how clinicians, care teams, administrators, and enterprise customers access and use UpToDate across web and mobile experiences.
  • Identifyopportunities to improve registration, login, authentication, SSO, account, identity, andentitlementworkflows.
  • Partner with engineering, architecture, security, implementation, and customer-facing teams to support scalable, customer-ready approaches to access, account, identity, and entitlement experiences.
  • Lead discovery and prioritization for core product improvements that enhance usability, accessibility, reliability, customer readiness, and overall product quality.
  • Manage roadmap priorities that balance product evolution with important customer requests, accessibility needs, operational improvements, and platform dependencies.
  • Help shape consistent, intuitive product experiences across core UpToDate web and mobile platforms.
  • Translate complex user, customer, technical, and business needs into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, roadmap priorities, and success metrics.
  • Partner with UX, analytics, engineering, commercial, customer success, implementation, support, and other product teams from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Use customer conversations, product analytics, stakeholder input, experimentation, and post-launch feedback to inform product direction and measure impact.
  • Make product decisions that balance user value, customer needs, technical feasibility, implementation complexity, accessibility, security, cost, risk, and business impact.
  • Communicate product priorities, rationale, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly across cross-functional teams and leadership.

WhatYou’llBring

  • 7+ years of product management experience in healthcare, enterprise SaaS, B2B software, workflow products, platform products, professional-information products, or other complex digital product environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to own a meaningful product area, set roadmap priorities, and deliver measurable outcomes across multiple capabilities or workstreams.
  • Strong product discovery and execution skills, including customer research, requirements definition, prioritization, roadmap development, experimentation, launch planning, and metrics-driven decision-making.
  • Experience translating complex user, customer, technical, operational, and business needs into practical product plans and intuitive product experiences.
  • Technical fluency with product areas that involve user access, account experience, authentication, identity, permissions, entitlements, enterprise administration, or implementation complexity.
  • Ability to partner effectively with engineering, UX, architecture, security, analytics, commercial, implementation, customer success, support, and product leadership teams.
  • Strong judgment in balancing strategic product opportunities with customer, accessibility, operational, and technical priorities.
  • Strong communication,stakeholder-management, analytical thinking, and influencing skills.
  • Ability tooperatein ambiguity, connect related workstreams into a coherent product direction, and drive alignment in a complex cross-functional environment.

Preferred Background

  • Experience with SSO, authentication, identity management, user account models, entitlements, permissions, registration, login, or enterprise access workflows.
  • Experience with healthcare technology, clinical decision support, regulated environments, accessibility requirements, or enterprise healthcare customers.
  • Experience improving web and mobile product experiences used by professional or enterprise users.
  • Experience modernizing established product experiences or evolving complex products across multiple platforms.
  • Experience working on products that require close coordination acrossproduct,platform, security, architecture, implementation, customer-facing, and commercial teams.
  • Familiarity with clinical workflows, healthcare content, point-of-care tools, orprofessional-informationproducts.

What Success Looks Like

  • Users can access UpToDate with minimal friction across registration, login, SSO, identity, and entitlement experiences.
  • Core UpToDate web and mobile experiences become more usable, accessible, reliable, and aligned with customer and user needs.
  • Product teams have a clearer roadmap for improving access, account experience, core product quality, and platform experience consistency.
  • Customer, accessibility, and operational product needs are prioritized and delivered with clarity, discipline, and measurable aimpact.
  • Cross-functional teams have clear priorities, decision rationale, success metrics, and shared understanding of tradeoffs, risks, and dependencies.
  • Product decisions balance user value, clinical trust, enterprise customer needs, technical feasibility, implementation complexity, security, accessibility, and business impact.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

$160,100.00 - $286,000.00 USDThis role is eligible for Bonus.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Your job is more than a job

Laissez les bons “codes” rouler! As a Senior Medical Coder, you determine the ICD-10-CM/PCS and CPT diagnostic and procedural codes like a top notch jazz musician choosing the appropriate MS-DRG and APR-DRG for patient records as you navigate across multiple specialties (cardiology, cardiothoracic surgery, trauma, orthopedics, general medicine and surgery, pediatrics, obstetrics, newborns, family medicine, internal medicine, surgery, interventional radiology, trauma, orthopedics, urology, gynecology, etc.).

As a valuable senior member of our merry band of coders, you set a positive tone sharing your professional expertise while guarding patient information like a secret family recipe. You love being a go-to resource for all things coding. You put the extra in extraordinary. We love that about you.

Your experiences, knowledge, special skills, team mentality, and your “little something extra” all add up to you. And we’re excited to get to know you and find out what you’ll bring to this senior medical coding role.

Your Everyday

  • Navigate the patient health record and other computer systems/sources to accurately determine diagnosis and procedures codes, MS-DRGs and APCs assignment and all required modifiers.
  • Validate charges by comparing charges with health record documentation as necessary.
  • Communicate effectively with clinical staff, physicians and office staff and Clinical Documentation Improvement Specialist regarding documentation issues or needs related to Inpatient, Outpatient, or Ambulatory coding.
  • Identify concerns and notify appropriate leadership for problem resolution.
  • Track issues (i.e. missing documentation, charges and physician queries) that require follow-up to facilitate coding in a timely fashion.
  • Meet and exceed coding quality and established productivity standards
  • Adhere to patient confidentiality requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of changes in coding and reimbursement guidelines and regulations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by leadership.
  • Maintain working knowledge of applicable coding and reimbursement Federal, State and local laws and regulations, the Code of Ethics, as well as other policies and procedures.

The Must-Haves

Minimum:

  • 2 years of experience as an outpatient or inpatient hospital or clinic coder.
  • High School Diploma, GED or equivalent or appropriate work experience in medical coding is required.

Preferred:

  • Associate degree in HIM or similar degree.
  • Completion of AHIMA approved coding program or AAPC coding program. One or more of the following:
  • Registered Health Information Technician from the Commission on Certification for Health Informatics and Information Management (CCHIIM)- AHIMA
  • Registered Health Information Administrator from the Commission on Certification for Health Informatics and Information Management (CCHIIM)- AHIMA
  • Certified Coding Specialist from the Commission on Certification for Health Informatics and Information Management (CCHIIM)

Days (United States of America)

Celebrating authenticity, originality, equity, inclusion and a little “come on in” attitude is the foundation of LCMC Health’s culture of everyday extraordinary

Your extras

  • Deliver healthcare with heart.
  • Give people a reason to smile.
  • Put a little love in your work.
  • Be honest and real, but with compassion.
  • Bring some lagniappe into everything you do.
  • Forget one-size-fits-all, think one-of-a-kind care.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and knowledgeable Medical Scribe to support healthcare providers with clinical documentation and administrative workflows during patient consultations.

In this role, you will work closely with physicians to document patient encounters in real time, prepare medical charts before appointments, assist with entering orders under physician instruction, and ensure clinical records are accurate, complete, and organized.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of medical terminology, excellent typing and listening skills, and experience working with electronic health records (EHRs). You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced clinical environment where accuracy, efficiency, confidentiality, and attention to detail are essential.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Real-Time Clinical Documentation

  • Accompany physicians during patient consultations and examinations to document clinical encounters in real time.
  • Record the patient's chief complaint, history of present illness, relevant medical history, physical examination findings, and assessment and treatment plan.
  • Accurately capture clinical information while listening to conversations between healthcare providers and patients.
  • Adapt to different physicians' documentation preferences and workflows.

Pre-Visit Chart Preparation

  • Review patient medical records before consultations.
  • Check medication lists, previous clinical notes, pending laboratory results, and imaging reports.
  • Ensure relevant information is available to the physician before the appointment.
  • Identify missing information or outstanding results that may require follow-up.

Orders & Referral Entry

  • Enter laboratory, diagnostic imaging, and other medical orders under the direct instruction of the physician and in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Assist with entering referrals and prescription information as authorized.
  • Ensure all entries are accurate and flag discrepancies or missing information for the provider's review.

Post-Visit Documentation & Chart Closure

  • Review and organize clinical notes following patient consultations.
  • Assist with visit summaries and supporting documentation.
  • Identify incomplete sections and flag records requiring physician review, correction, or signature.
  • Help ensure patient charts are completed accurately and within the required timeframes.

Coding, Compliance & Confidentiality

  • Ensure documentation captures the clinical details required to support accurate medical coding and billing.
  • Follow applicable patient privacy, confidentiality, and healthcare documentation requirements.
  • Maintain the accuracy and integrity of electronic medical records.
  • Handle sensitive patient information responsibly and in accordance with applicable privacy regulations, including HIPAA where relevant.

Clinical Workflow Support

  • Assist with patient flow by keeping documentation up to date and helping reduce administrative backlogs.
  • Manage multiple documentation tasks and outstanding items efficiently.
  • Communicate with physicians and relevant clinical staff regarding incomplete records or documentation discrepancies.
  • Maintain organized records and follow established clinical workflows.

Minimum Requirements

  • Previous experience as a Medical Scribe or in a closely related clinical documentation role is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, common diagnoses, and clinical abbreviations.
  • Experience using electronic health record (EHR) systems such as Epic, Cerner, Allscripts, or similar platforms.
  • Excellent typing speed and accuracy; a typing speed of 60–80 words per minute is preferred.
  • Strong written English skills and the ability to produce clear, accurate clinical documentation.
  • Excellent listening skills and the ability to capture relevant clinical details during live consultations.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify missing or inconsistent information.
  • Understanding of patient confidentiality and healthcare privacy requirements.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

Essential Skills & Competencies

  • Clinical documentation: Ability to accurately capture patient information and physician instructions.
  • Medical terminology: Familiarity with common clinical terms, diagnoses, medications, and procedures.
  • Attention to detail: Ensures accurate documentation of medication dosages, clinical findings, and patient history.
  • Active listening: Distinguishes important clinical information from general conversation.
  • Time management: Completes documentation promptly while managing multiple tasks.
  • Adaptability: Adjusts to different physician preferences, specialties, and documentation workflows.
  • Confidentiality: Handles sensitive medical information professionally and securely.
  • Communication: Works effectively with physicians and clinical teams to resolve documentation gaps.

What Success Looks Like

  • Patient encounters are documented accurately and in real time.
  • Clinical notes are complete, clear, and organized.
  • Medical orders and referrals are entered correctly under physician instruction.
  • Incomplete records are flagged promptly for provider review.
  • Patient information remains confidential and is handled in accordance with applicable regulations.
  • Documentation is completed efficiently, supporting smooth clinical operations and reducing administrative backlogs.

Important Note

The Medical Scribe supports the physician by documenting clinical information and carrying out authorized administrative tasks. Clinical decisions, diagnosis, treatment recommendations, and final approval or signature of clinical records remain the responsibility of the appropriately licensed healthcare provider.

If you have strong medical terminology knowledge, excellent attention to detail, and experience supporting clinical documentation, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

UCAR is excited to announce the job opening for the CPAESS Scientist III position, supporting NOAA's Climate Prediction Center (CPC) at the National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) under NOAA's Early Warning Systems (NEWS) program. The incumbent will independently lead the application of advanced forecasting methods (including AI/ML and ensemble post-processing) to improve sub-seasonal to seasonal (S2S) predictions of extreme climate events. The CPAESS Scientist III will serve as a primary point of contact for stakeholder engagement, driving the co-development of impact forecasts and training programs with partners in the Caribbean and Latin America, or Africa, and must demonstrate professional bilingual proficiency in English and French.

CPAESS serves the Earth system science community in three distinct areas of service. CPAESS partners with federal agencies and businesses to hire critical scientific staff, enabling a more robust workforce. Through scientific programs, CPAESS seeks to edify new research with postdoctoral programs, visiting scientist and internship programs, along with interagency support programs. CPAESS also helps build the Earth system science community by convening and managing summer schools and institutes, conferences, and advisory committees. Through Scientific Partnerships, CPAESS supports large-scale partnerships and initiatives in the Earth system science (ESS) community. Currently, there are about 100 scientists in a variety of federal agencies and laboratories across the U.S.

Job Description

Designs and executes scientific analyses; develops, and adapts, and/or tests hypotheses, models and/or tools. Contributes to papers, reports, technical documentation, data sets, findings, and/or proposals. Mentors less experienced colleagues, collaborates across disciplines, and supports proposal development to advance scientific goals through high-quality, methodologically sound work. Engages in mission-aligned activities both within the organization and throughout the broader scientific community. Contributes through a combination of scientific expertise, professional service, and education and outreach efforts.


Responsibilities

  • Designing and executing scientific investigations or analyses using established and/or emerging methods to address defined research, operational, or applied science questions.
  • Developing or adapting tools, models, or methods to support data collection, processing, analysis, system evaluation, or experimental workflows.
  • Performing detailed analysis and interpretation of observational, experimental, or model-generated data, contributing to new insights or improvements in scientific understanding.
  • Leading or contributing to components of a larger project or small project teams through coordination of activities, deliverables, and technical direction across collaborators.
  • Authoring or co-authoring peer-reviewed publications, technical documentation, data sets, findings, project reports, and/or proposals, and presenting findings in internal, sponsor, or scientific community settings.
  • Collaborating across disciplines and institutions, contributing technical expertise to team-based projects and enhancing interdisciplinary research or operational outcomes.
  • Supporting proposal development and project planning activities by contributing to scoping, technical writing, and alignment with programmatic objectives.
  • Providing technical guidance to less experienced staff/students, mentoring on methods, tools, and best practices while engaging in and modeling inclusive team participation.
  • Developing products, tools, instruments and/or technologies for projects and programs.

Requirements


Education


Typically requires a minimum of a Bachelor of Science degree and 8 years related experience, or a Master’s degree and 4 years related experience, or a PhD in a scientific discipline; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Knowledge

  • Has solid knowledge in a relevant scientific field, with an ability to apply theories, methods, or frameworks to complex or interdisciplinary problems.
  • Is familiar with project planning and proposal development, including scoping technical work, aligning with program goals, and supporting deliverable management.

Skills and Abilities

  • Is skilled in developing or refining scientific tools, workflows, or models, including quality assurance and integration with broader project efforts.
  • Is skilled in using data analysis tools used for data preparation, visualization, or workflow automation.
  • Is committed to mentoring with the ability to guide less experienced colleagues on methods, tools, and collaborative practices.
  • Is capable of contributing to peer-reviewed publications, sponsor reports, or presentations, with clear and accurate scientific communication tailored to varied audiences.
  • Collaborates effectively within multidisciplinary teams, integrating diverse inputs and fostering productive working relationships.
  • Demonstrates the ability to design and carry out analyses or investigative tasks independently using established methods, adapting approaches as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Skills & Experience

  • Strong knowledge of the global climate system, with regional expertise in the Caribbean, Latin America, or Africa at S2S timescales.
  • Experience engaging stakeholders in agriculture, water resource management, or food security in developing-world contexts.
  • Familiarity with operational forecast workflows, including model output processing, forecast verification, and communicating uncertainty to end users.
  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and French to effectively communicate technical scientific information to clients and stakeholders.

Program/Project-Specific Details

  • Contribute to the development and delivery of training materials on subseasonal to seasonal (S2S) forecasting for meteorologists, scientists, and stakeholders across agriculture, water resource management, and health sectors.
  • Author technical and scientific reports documenting work related to the PREPARE Early Warning System project.

Role-Specific Responsibilities

  • Apply advanced scientific methods — including model calibration, bias correction, and AI/ML tools — to post-process global ensemble forecasts (GEFS, NMME, and others) and improve precipitation and temperature forecasts at week 2–4, monthly, and seasonal timescales.
  • Verify forecasts using statistical methods and apply multivariate and spectral analysis to observations and model outputs to understand and advance sub-seasonal predictability, including prediction of extreme events.
  • Use GIS tools to map extreme event forecasts and collaborate with stakeholders to co-develop impact forecasts for agriculture, water resource management, and health.

Additional Information

Start Date: Candidates selected for hire must undergo a federal screening in addition to a standard background check (learn more). The start date will be confirmed upon successful completion of the federal screening.


Work Location Expectations: This position is open to candidates seeking in-person, hybrid (combination of 3 days in-person and 2 days of remote), or fully remote opportunities. UCAR requires ALL positions to be performed within the U.S., excluding U.S. Territories. UCAR Staff deployed to federal agencies must abide by their respective federal agency requirements concerning remote/flexible work arrangements.



Application Requirements

Cover Letter, Resume/CV

For full consideration, all application materials must be submitted by 12am (MST) at the start of the application deadline. These should highlight how your skills and experiences align with the responsibilities of this position. We recognize that no candidate will meet 100% of the listed qualifications. If you believe your background has prepared you for success in this role, we encourage you to apply.


Supplemental questionnaires are often requested in lieu of a cover letter, where you address critical skills needed for the position. Your answers will be read and weighed equally to your resume and should provide specific, detailed, and informative responses based on your direct and previous work experiences.


Background checks and/or federal screenings are conducted for candidates selected for hire.


Benefits Overview



UCAR offers a comprehensive benefits package: health insurance, dental, retirement plan, leave plans, tuition assistance, and employee assistance programs:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Short & Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Generous retirement plan - UCAR contributes of 10% of base salary
  • Time Off Plans
    • Minimum 20 days of annual PTO
    • 10 paid holidays
    • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
    • FAMLI Leave
  • Tuition Assistance Program
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligible employer

UCAR is an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcomes applications from all individuals. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, age, sex, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Applicants are not required to provide age-related information (like date of birth or graduation dates) in initial submissions.


For sponsored positions: UCAR can sponsor individuals for H-1B status only if they are already in the U.S. in H-1B status or another visa status that allows them to change to H-1B status within the U.S. UCAR is unable to sponsor new H-1B visas for individuals who are outside the U.S. and need to obtain H-1B status through Consular Processing.


While UCAR does not prohibit the use of AI tools in job applications, we strongly recommend that applicants submit primarily original work.


All roles require compliance with U.S. export control regulations and work location requirements. All hybrid staff are expected to work on-site approximately 3 days per week.

description: The PositionBallotpedia is seeking a full-time, 100% remote Staff Researcher to join our News Team.

raw.title: News Team Staff Researcher
raw.excerpt: The PositionBallotpedia is seeking a full-time, 100% remote Staff Researcher to join our News Team.
raw.description:
The Position

Ballotpedia is seeking a full-time, 100% remote Staff Researcher to join our News Team.

The News Team is responsible for identifying and capturing mission-related news events to provide audiences with clear, accurate, and impartial political information. We track and update readers on hard-to-find items, from state legislative candidate declarations and unscheduled officeholder transitions to political party ballot status across the United States and its territories. We strive to provide any interested party with the details that comprise our complex political landscape.

A successful staff researcher will be passionate and knowledgeable about politics. They will be comfortable conducting and organizing extensive research using various media, political websites, and official government sources. They must have the ability to distill complex topics into neutral and concise information for a variety of audiences. They will also be comfortable producing work under regular deadlines and flexible enough to reprioritize work when unexpected events unfold in the political world.

A strong candidate for this role will have a driving desire for accuracy, completeness, innovation, and neutrality. They will demonstrate excellent writing and proofreading skills, as well as a passion for improvement and innovation. Constructive feedback is welcome and taken as an opportunity for growth. The candidate should be comfortable researching obscure information online and conducting direct outreach to government officials as needed. An ideal candidate will also be eager to collaborate within the News Team and across Ballotpedia’s other departments.

Responsibilities

As a News Team Staff Researcher, you will:

  • Monitor a specific list of sources to identify breaking news updates, including media and political websites, and official government sources
  • Update relevant articles based on identified stories
  • Work extensively within Ballotpedia’s database to track and update information
  • Ensure data accuracy on-site and in the database
  • Conduct regular reviews (or “sweeps”) of lists of officeholders and candidates at the federal, state, and local levels of government to ensure Ballotpedia’s data is accurate
  • Follow carefully laid out processes, systems, and procedures as assigned by editors and supervisors
  • Generate content about complex topics in a neutral, clear, and concise manner
  • Conduct systematic research to collect data related to officeholders, candidates, and elections. Data points will include, but are not limited to, campaign or official website addresses, social media handles, and upcoming election dates
  • Proofread content effectively, efficiently, and consistently
  • Interact with co-workers, customers, and the media in a professional, helpful, and pleasant manner
  • Conduct research about jurisdictions not currently receiving detailed coverage on Ballotpedia for potential inclusion on our site and in our database
  • Complete designated tracking spreadsheets to capture the number and types of updates that are made over time

Skills and Qualifications

An ideal News Team Staff Researcher will possess:

  • A demonstrated passion for Ballotpedia’s mission
  • Knowledge of the United States' political system and elections
  • Experience working with databases and spreadsheets
  • Experience in writing and/or editing (with experience as a professional writer and/or editor preferred)
  • Superb organizational skills and a focus on detail
  • Self-awareness and a drive toward constant improvement
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • A desire to work collaboratively with Ballotpedia staff from multiple departments
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to multitask, set priorities, and follow through
  • A drive for innovation and flexibility, and an ability to identify and solve problems proactively
  • A willingness to work periodic evenings and weekends
  • Interest in or experience using AI tools to increase productivity

Environment

The News Team Staff Researcher will work remotely from their home location. All Ballotpedia staff work remotely. To join Ballotpedia, you must have a computer with Internet access. Ballotpedia utilizes Google Suite (Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive, and more), Slack, and Asana to achieve our goals. Some familiarity with the Google Suite, Slack, and Asana is helpful.

Ballotpedia offers a flexible work environment, BP Flex, which allows every employee to enjoy unlimited vacation and flexibility in scheduling. Each employee will be oriented to the principles of Ballotpedia’s flexible environment during new employee training.

Compensation

The starting pay range for the News Team Staff Researcher is $42,500-$44,000, commensurate with experience.

In addition to salary, Ballotpedia offers an annual benefits stipend equivalent to $8,000 that is paid out in equal increments in each paycheck once an employee becomes benefits eligible. The stipend may be used to pay for a full benefits package, including health, vision, and dental insurance; retirement accounts; and more. If benefits are not elected, the stipend is taxed as regular income and added to salary.

To Apply

To apply, click on ‘Apply for this job’ below and fill out the form. Please attach the following in PDF format if possible:

  • résumé
  • cover letter detailing your interest in Ballotpedia’s mission/this position
  • neutral writing sample (under five pages), included in the same file as your cover letter

Please ensure that either your résumé or your cover letter includes your current address.

Please note that if you are hired for this position, Ballotpedia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, Ballotpedia is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9. For more information on E-Verify, or if you believe that your employer has violated its E-Verify responsibilities, please contact DHS.

About Ballotpedia

Ballotpedia is a mission-driven organization dedicated to providing Americans with accurate, relevant, and unbiased information about politics, elections, and public policy. Our mission is to ensure that the only unknown on your ballot is who gets your vote. We value innovation, humility, intellectual curiosity, drive, and a collaborative spirit and are committed to continuously improving our offerings to better serve our audiences, readers, and candidates.

As a Team Lead, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), you'll play a critical role in improving financial outcomes for healthcare providers while leading a high-performing team. You'll own the performance of an assigned portfolio of client accounts, using data and operational insight to identify reimbursement trends, reduce denials, improve revenue cycle performance, and create measurable client impact. Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Senior Manager, Network Planning provides enterprise-level leadership for network capacity, investment, and deployment planning across assigned technologies, markets, or programs. This role converts business demand, network performance, customer commitments, and technology strategy into prioritized, executable network plans. The Senior Manager leads managers and/or senior professional teams, establishes operating discipline, and is accountable for measurable planning outcomes, capital stewardship, delivery confidence, and executive visibility.

Operating with broad autonomy, this leader shapes multi-year planning strategy, resolves complex cross-functional dependencies, and influences decisions across Product, Architecture and Engineering, Finance, Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Implementation. The role requires strong technical judgment, business acumen, people leadership, and the ability to communicate risk, options, and recommendations clearly to senior executives.

Location and Schedule

This is a full time remote/work from home position in the USA. The typical schedule is Monday-Friday 8am-5pm. May require occasional weekends or evenings depending on the needs of the business.

The Main Responsibilities

Strategic Network Planning & Portfolio Leadership
  • Lead strategy, priorities, and operating plans for a portfolio spanning capacity, modernization, optimization, and growth.
  • Translate business strategy, product roadmaps, demand forecasts, and network constraints into multi-year investment plans with defined outcomes.
  • Drive integrated planning across network domains to ensure end-to-end alignment and effective investment decisions.
  • Establish governance, decision frameworks, and escalation paths while providing senior leaders with recommendations and tradeoffs.
Capital Governance & Business Outcomes
  • Lead capital planning, prioritization, forecasting, and variance management to balance customer needs, growth, risk reduction, and network efficiency.
  • Develop investment proposals with clear business rationale, scope, dependencies, milestones, benefits, and financial impact.
  • Partner with Finance and delivery teams to manage commitments, spending, forecast accuracy, and recovery plans.
  • Improve capital efficiency through optimization, architectural alternatives, commercial options, and process improvements.
Operational Execution, Risk & Delivery
  • Convert planning decisions into executable projects with defined scope, ownership, funding, and delivery readiness.
  • Manage dependencies across engineering, procurement, operations, implementation, vendors, and business stakeholders.
  • Lead portfolio risk and issue management, including mitigation plans and executive escalation.
  • Measure network health, forecast quality, delivery readiness, capital efficiency, and business impact.
Data, Automation & Decision Intelligence
  • Champion data-driven planning through improved data quality, analytics, and decision transparency.
  • Lead dashboards, scorecards, scenario modeling, and automated reporting to improve visibility and efficiency.
  • Leverage analytics, AI-enabled tools, and predictive methods to identify constraints, evaluate alternatives, improve forecasts, and accelerate decisions.
  • Ensure governance, validation, and accountability for automated and AI-assisted insights.
Executive Communication & Cross-Functional Influence
  • Represent Network Planning in executive reviews, investment discussions, and cross-functional decision forums.
  • Translate complex technical and financial information into clear business impacts, recommendations, risks, and actions.
  • Build stakeholder alignment by framing options, facilitating decisions, and driving accountability.
  • Influence outcomes through strong cross-functional partnerships.
People Leadership & Organizational Capability
  • Lead, coach, and develop managers, planners, analysts, and technical professionals while setting clear performance expectations.
  • Build a high-performing organization through talent planning, succession management, and development.
  • Align resources to strategic priorities, address capability gaps, and adapt team structures as business needs evolve.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.
Scope & Decision Accountability
  • Own outcomes across a significant network planning portfolio, multiple programs, or broad geographic and technology scope.
  • Make and recommend decisions involving capital priorities, customer impacts, operational risk, technical options, and delivery constraints.
  • Operate independently on complex issues, escalating with recommendations when enterprise tradeoffs are required.
  • Retain accountability for portfolio health, execution, and results.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Finance, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in network planning, telecommunications, infrastructure strategy, engineering, operations, financial planning, or a related discipline.
  • 3+ years of formal people leadership experience, including responsibility for performance, development, prioritization, and organizational outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional portfolios or programs with material capital, customer, operational, or strategic impact.
  • Strong knowledge of network capacity planning, forecasting, infrastructure investment, project lifecycle, and operational risk management.
  • Proven financial acumen, including capital planning, business-case development, prioritization, forecasting, and variance management.
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present concise recommendations and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Experience using analytics, dashboards, and planning tools to improve decisions, transparency, and execution.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, establish operating structure, and deliver results across organizational boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Experience leading managers or a multi-layered team in a large, matrixed organization.
  • Deep experience in one or more network domains such as IP, transport, metro, fiber, broadband access, data center, or critical infrastructure planning.
  • Experience with network modernization, capacity expansion, customer-driven builds, optimization, and large-scale transformation programs.
  • Advanced proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, Excel, automation platforms, AI-enabled productivity tools, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience managing vendor, contract, or service-level dependencies that affect portfolio delivery and business outcomes.
