  • Strategic Alignment — Work closely with cross‑functional teams to ensure strategic cohesion without performing executional tasks.
  • Performance Interpretation — Interpret high‑level campaign results and translate them into strategic insights and recommendations.
  • Client Communication — Present strategies, audience plans, and campaign frameworks clearly and persuasively.
  • Executive Stakeholder Engagement — Communicate complex marketing strategies, audience insights, and recommendations with confidence, influencing Director-, VP-, and C-level stakeholders to drive alignment and decision-making.

Required Qualifications

  • 7 to 12 years of experience in an agency or similar environment managing multiple client strategies concurrently.
  • Proven ability to build campaign strategies, define target audiences, and map lead‑to‑customer journeys.
  • Understanding of segmentation, deciles, scoring models, and how audience selection impacts campaign outcomes.
  • Strong ability to write structured, actionable BRDs.
  • Deep intuition for funnel movement and the KPIs that matter at each stage.
  • Ability to juggle multiple strategies, deadlines, and ad‑hoc requests without sacrificing quality.
  • Experience across all funnel stages, including prospect, lead, and customer.
  • Skilled at articulating strategy to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Experience identifying workflow gaps and proposing scalable solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience partnering with analytics teams and interpreting their outputs.

  • Identify and source qualified tour guides through local directories, social media platforms, tourism communities, referrals, guide marketplaces, universities, and other sourcing channels.
  • Build relationships with tourism departments, faculty members, student organizations, guide associations, tourism offices, and other industry stakeholders to develop sustainable sourcing pipelines.
  • Conduct detailed research on prospective partners, including background verification, tour products, certifications, language capabilities, customer reviews, and professional reputation.
  • Perform structured screening interviews to evaluate candidates' professionalism, destination knowledge, storytelling ability, customer service skills, and operational readiness.
  • Assess and rank candidates based on defined evaluation criteria, maintaining an organized pipeline of qualified guide partners.
  • Prepare candidate profiles, recommendations, and shortlists for management review while providing clear assessments of strengths, development areas, and market suitability.
  • Support partnership negotiations, onboarding activities, contract coordination, scheduling arrangements, and initial operational setup for new guide partners.
  • Continuously explore and evaluate new sourcing channels, industry events, alumni networks, community groups, and tourism organizations to expand recruitment effectiveness.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, monitor sourcing performance, conversion metrics, and partnership progress while preparing regular pipeline reports.
  • Collect feedback from guide partners and operational activities to improve sourcing strategies, selection criteria, onboarding processes, and partnership performance.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality, Tourism Management, Human Resources, Marketing, or other related disciplines is preferred.
  • Minimum 1–3 years of experience in business development, recruitment, partnerships, hospitality, tourism operations, or related functions.
  • Experience sourcing, screening, interviewing, or onboarding candidates, partners, contractors, or service providers.
  • Familiarity with local tourism ecosystems, guide associations, tourism institutions, or university networks is highly preferred.
  • Strong interviewing, candidate assessment, relationship-building, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience negotiating basic commercial terms and coordinating partnership agreements is advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sourcing pipelines simultaneously.
  • Experience working with tour operators, destination management companies (DMCs), travel marketplaces, or university career services will be an advantage.
  • Experience evaluating multilingual candidates or onboarding freelance professionals is preferred.
  • Understanding of local tour guide licensing or certification requirements is considered a plus.
  • Strong research, analytical, and candidate evaluation capabilities.
  • Professional relationship management skills with the ability to engage educators, tourism organizations, associations, and independent professionals.
  • Strong organizational skills with experience maintaining CRM systems, recruitment databases, and reporting metrics.
  • Good negotiation skills and the ability to facilitate partnership discussions professionally.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, adaptable, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with internal stakeholders.
  • Good English communication skills are preferred, while additional local language proficiency will be considered an advantage depending on the target market.

Aqui, a gente não vende só tecnologia. A gente vende transformação.

raw.description:
Clearwaters.IT is seeking a highly motivated and self-directed professional to fill an opening for a Senior Functional Analyst role that will be responsible for leading the capturing of business requirements for software development teams. This role involves close collaboration with business users, IT teams, and leadership to elaborate and document requirements, and manage requirements in an Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) tool. The ideal candidate has a strong background in software development, and Agile / SAFe methodologies.

This position is 100% remote. Candidate MUST reside within the United States to be considered.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Perform Agile requirements' management activities for a product team; perform the analysis of user needs to determine functional, cross-functional, and technical requirements
  • Conduct user interviews, leading and facilitating sessions, and developing business process models and formal specifications
  • Work with customers, team members, stakeholder users, and other contractors to gather, and document business, functional, technical & non-technical requirements
  • Perform elaboration of user stories and decomposition of stories into backlog items and determine acceptance criteria
  • Use an Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) tool (JIRA) for Requirements Management, Testing, and Defect Management) to create and manage requirements, Epics, Sub-epics, and User Stories.
  • Collection, tracking and monitoring of system and business requirements
  • Validate requirements and integration
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions
  • Coordinate with Systems Engineers to assess impact on technical solutions
  • Manage and coordinate requirements for various projects
  • Writing and client delivery of project documents
  • Identify and manage risks and issues impacting the progress and outcome of the project
  • Develop and maintain scheduled project/product backlog(s)
  • Own and manage requirements change control
  • Develop Change Requests per established policies and procedures
  • Facilitate accurate configuration management for project related artifacts
  • Identify, document, verify and track traceability amongst requirements, test cases and potential risks and impediments
  • Responsible for collecting, analyzing, managing and reporting key Program and Product Team execution status and metrics across all aspects of the Agile product development lifecycle using SAFe.
  • Perform analysis to identify required tasks and their interrelationships to establish well documented stories
  • Become a product functional SME.
  • Lead and mentor junior analysts in accordance with strategy and direction established by the Team Lead
  • Establish strong relationships with product and business owners
  • Support development team as needed to help everyone understand the requirements’ details.
  • Follow agile methodology (Scrum) and deliver requirements/specifications for Sprint teams
  • Remove impediments from team members to achieve successful completion of Sprints
  • Provide clear qualitative and quantitative information to teams and stakeholders
  • Support change control processes established to monitor and control project scope

Requirements

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance
  • Solid oral and written communication skills, with the demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical topics to the customer, management and non-technical audiences
  • Attention to detail and excellent customer service
  • Highly motivated and analytical; proven problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to take initiative
  • Ability and enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced environment
  • Willingness and enthusiasm to learn new skills, new client environments, and grow domain expertise
  • Ability to learn quickly
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to conduct independent research to lead or support the resolution of complex questions and issues
  • Advanced use of MS Office Suite including strong Excel skills
  • Excellent analytical skills, the ability to integrate information from multiple sources to execute effectively and efficiently in a dynamic environment
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team setting​​​
  • Experience working at the US Department of Veterans Affairs
  • Experience working in an Agile environment is preferred
  • Expertise with Jira tools
  • Working knowledge of VA’s VIP agile process is highly desired
  • VA SQA Testing experience highly desired
  • Experience in large, agile software development or data integration projects
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) is a plus
  • Must have experience working with customers, users and project leads in analyzing, designing, implementing and supporting a wide variety of IT business systems covering many diverse applications such as healthcare and financial systems.
  • Fully understands the process to elicit customer / end user requirements in software application lifecycle environment
  • Strong experience in requirements elaboration and acceptance criteria development
  • Experience working in a SAFe Agile environment
  • Experience working for a Federal Health Agency (VA, DHA, HHS, etc.) strongly preferred
  • Healthcare billing and claims processing application knowledge is strongly preferred

Required Education and Experience:

  • Master’s degree in engineering, or related scientific or technical discipline and ten (10) years of experience
  • 10 years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for education

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401K, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays

raw.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP FICO Consultant to lead the SAP ECC FI/CO workstream for the integration of a recently acquired subsidiary and the implementation of dual-ledger financial reporting to support both International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).
raw.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP FICO Consultant to lead the SAP ECC FI/CO workstream for the integration of a recently acquired subsidiary and the implementation of dual-ledger financial reporting to support both International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).

The successful candidate will act as the SAP FI/CO Project Lead, functional implementation specialist, and business super user, taking ownership of the end-to-end FI/CO delivery lifecycle, including solution design, data migration, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live hypercare.

The role will work closely with the DT (Digital Technology) lead, who is responsible for overall SAP integration and administration, as well as Finance, Controlling, and other relevant business stakeholders, to ensure a controlled, accurate, and successful integration.

Who Are We?

Decision Inc. is a global digital partner that enables businesses to reinvent themselves to realise their full potential.

We deliver agility, resilience, and intelligence to any enterprise, enabling them to adapt quickly and thrive through innovation and opportunity. Our teams have engaged with more than 400 clients globally over the past 15 years, providing them with the expertise to build, operate, and optimise their digital businesses.

We achieve this by leveraging the world's best technology to drive our client's business ambitions forward into tomorrow's reality. These technologies include but are not limited to: Microsoft, SAP, Qlik, Snowflake, Alteryx, Automation Anywhere, and Workday Adaptive Insights.

Our success is ultimately driven by our entrepreneurial culture, industry exposure, and the passion of our people. We have three key cross-functional teams – Functional and Specialist Consulting, Development, and Engineering teams. Based in four global offices, our exceptional consultants focus on delivering value to clients by keeping them at the centre of our service delivery. To find out more about our exciting fast-paced culture visit: Careers at Decision Inc.

What Will You Do?

Key Responsibility:

SAP FI/CO Workstream Leadership

  • Lead the SAP ECC FI/CO workstream for the integration of the acquired subsidiary.
  • Own the FI/CO project plan, deliverables, milestones, risks, dependencies, and issue resolution.
  • Serve as the primary functional point of contact for SAP FI/CO design decisions and implementation activities.
  • Partner closely with the DT lead to align FI/CO requirements with the overall SAP integration architecture, technical delivery, and system administration.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Controlling, and business process owners to ensure operational and reporting requirements are met.

Dual-Ledger Accounting and Multi-GAAP Reporting

  • Design and implement SAP ECC solutions to support parallel accounting and dual-ledger reporting under IFRS and US GAAP.
  • Assess existing financial processes and identify the configuration and process changes required to accommodate multiple accounting standards.
  • Define and validate ledger structures, accounting principles, posting approaches, and reporting requirements, as applicable to the existing SAP ECC landscape.
  • Ensure appropriate treatment of accounting adjustments, intercompany transactions, financial postings, and period-end activities.
  • Support reconciliation between IFRS and US GAAP financial results and ensure the integrity and traceability of financial data.
  • Collaborate with Finance stakeholders to validate accounting treatments and obtain sign-off on the proposed solution.

SAP ECC FI/CO Functional Design and Configuration

  • Lead functional assessments, requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution design, and configuration of SAP ECC FI/CO.
  • Provide deep functional expertise across relevant areas, including:
    • Financial Accounting (FI): General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, and Bank Accounting.
    • Controlling (CO): Cost Centres, Internal Orders, Profit Centres, and relevant management accounting processes.
    • Master data governance, chart of accounts alignment, posting controls, document processing, and financial close.
  • Assess the acquired subsidiary's existing SAP and finance processes and define the target-state solution.
  • Ensure consistent financial master data, accounting structures, and business processes across the integrated environment.

Data Migration and Reconciliation

  • Lead FI/CO data migration planning and execution for the acquired subsidiary.
  • Define and validate data mapping, transformation rules, cleansing requirements, and migration controls.
  • Oversee mock conversions, migration rehearsals, validation activities, and final production migration.
  • Reconcile migrated balances and transactions against source-system records and approved financial control totals.
  • Validate master data, opening balances, open items, fixed assets, and other relevant financial data.
  • Investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions within agreed project timelines.

Testing, Cutover, and Go-Live

  • Develop and manage the FI/CO testing strategy, including functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
  • Prepare test scenarios covering financial postings, ledger-specific accounting, reconciliations, period-end processing, and financial reporting.
  • Coordinate defect management, prioritisation, resolution, retesting, and business acceptance.
  • Lead FI/CO cutover planning, readiness assessments, data validation, reconciliation sign-offs, and go-live activities.
  • Provide hands-on support during deployment and stabilisation to ensure business continuity and financial data integrity.
  • Lead post-go-live hypercare, resolving functional issues and supporting the transition to business-as-usual operations.

Governance, Controls, and Compliance

  • Ensure SAP FI/CO changes comply with SOX requirements, internal financial controls, and established change and release management procedures.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation of solution designs, configuration decisions, migration reconciliations, testing evidence, and approvals.
  • Support audit requirements by ensuring financial transactions and accounting adjustments are traceable and appropriately controlled.
  • Identify project risks and control gaps and implement mitigation measures in collaboration with Finance and DT stakeholders.

Who Do You Need to Be?

  • Minimum 10 years of SAP FI/CO functional consulting experience, with substantial hands-on experience in SAP ECC.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering SAP integrations arising from mergers, acquisitions, or subsidiary integrations.
  • Proven experience implementing or supporting parallel accounting, dual-ledger solutions, and multi-GAAP financial reporting environments, specifically IFRS and US GAAP.
  • Strong SAP ECC FI/CO configuration and functional design expertise.
  • Extensive understanding of financial master data, transaction processing, general ledger postings, period-end close, and financial reconciliation processes.
  • Proven experience managing financial data migration, including mapping, mock conversions, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare activities.
  • Experience working in controlled corporate environments with SOX compliance, audit requirements, and formal change and release management processes.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and resolve critical issues under tight project deadlines.

About the Role:

At TELUS Digital, we help the world’s biggest brands build smarter technology. As a E-commerce Product & Search Relevancy Expert, your mission is to help an AI learn how to suggest the perfect products to online shoppers. You will look at massive catalogs across various industries and decide which items belong together. You act as the "human logic" that ensures a customer sees a matching set or compatible accessories instead of a random, incorrect suggestion.

What You’ll Do:

  • Create Pairs: Match products based on color, pattern, and style so they are visually consistent.

  • Check Compatibility: Ensure products actually work together for the same use case. (Example: Matching the right technical gear for specific sub-disciplines like gravel biking vs. road cycling).

  • Review Metadata: Look at gender, price segment, and seasonality to ensure recommendations are logically and commercially sound.

  • Maintain Data Integrity: Keep a clean, structured list of matches that follow strict brand and category guidelines.

  • Category Research: Quickly learn the nuances of new product domains to pick the best matches. (Example: Researching technical differences in skiing, cycling, or gym fitness gear).

Qualification path

  • Experience: A proven track record in search relevancy, product categorization, or e-commerce content moderation and annotation.

  • Education: A minimum of a Bachelor's in any field.

  • Analytical Skills: The ability to learn and differentiate between technical product categories quickly.

  • Attention to Detail: High sensitivity to visual aesthetics and the ability to spot subtle mismatches in style or price positioning.

  • Efficiency: Comfortable navigating large datasets and high-volume SKU catalogs while maintaining quality standards.

  • English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level to navigate technical documentation and product attributes.

Professional Experience: Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:

  • E-commerce product catalog management or product data analysis.

  • Product recommendations, search relevance, or product matching.

  • Online retail merchandising, product categorization, or taxonomy management.

  • Product compatibility analysis or technical product research.

  • Fashion, sporting goods, consumer electronics, or other product-specific retail domains.

Required Skills:

  • Strong analytical and research skills.

  • Ability to assess product similarity, compatibility and relevance.

  • Attention to detail when reviewing product attributes, metadata and categorization.

  • Ability to interpret product specifications and apply category-specific guidelines.

  • Strong written comprehension and decision-making skills.

In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification.

  • Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects.

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Job Description

Marketing Manager, Patient Access & Reimbursement - Multiple Therapeutic Areas


Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will report to the Associate Director of Patient Access & Reimbursement (PAR) Marketing and support the development and execution of access marketing strategy for assigned brands and initiatives. You will be responsible for developing tactics, messaging, and resources to support brand access strategy, to improve access to our products and deliver an outstanding customer and patient experience.

This role offers the opportunity to support a diverse portfolio of established brands across multiple therapeutic areas, including oncology. You will gain exposure to different treatment journeys, patient access challenges, and customer needs while identifying opportunities and developing targeted solutions to improve patient access and support across the product lifecycle.


Key responsibilities include:


Patient Access Strategy, Tactics & Insights

  • Support development of patient access strategy and lead tactical planning for assigned brands.
  • Build an understanding of customer needs by working with Brand, Sales, and Payer teams.
  • Perform situational analysis synthesizing insights from market research and analysis, field teams and customers to identify patient access needs and opportunities for improvement; recommend tactics or new access offerings based on findings.
  • Uses feedback and results to assess tactics and recommend refinements.

Access Marketing Resources

  • Develop and execute tools, resources, and communications that bring patient access strategies to life for field teams, HCPs, and patients. Examples may include customer-facing and patient marketing materials, multichannel content, speaker decks, and internal or external communications.
  • Lead marketing and communication materials through the appropriate internal review and approval processes, coordinating cross-functional input and timely submission.

Field Enablement

  • Listens to field needs and supports effective use of access programs, tools, and communications.
  • Develop and deliver training on programs and resources for field teams and Key Account Managers, and provide support to field staff to address questions (e.g., Field calls, National Sales/Semester meetings, leadership calls, and other forums).
  • Serve as a resource to field teams on payer and access support services, and build strong relationships with field staff at all levels.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Compliance

  • Partner with Brand Marketing, Medical, Market Research, Competitive Intelligence, Business Analytics, Sales Operations, and Sales Training to align PAR tactics and deliverables with brand priorities and the evolving market landscape, and coordinate field readiness.
  • Partner with PAR teams, including HUB, Value & Access Insights, Co-pay, Field Reimbursement Specialists, and Patient Navigators to align operational plans and execution with brand strategy and patient access needs.
  • Work with Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, and other internal partners to support compliant programs and materials.

Project & Budget Management

  • Manage assigned projects and agency or vendor workstreams, including timelines, deliverables, budget inputs, and day-to-day coordination.
  • Manage budgets for assigned brands, including annual planning, tracking, issue resolution, and coordination with Finance and cross-functional partners.

AI-Enabled Tools and Ways of Working

  • Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools to enhance insight generation, content development, project management, and execution quality while maintaining appropriate compliance, privacy, and human oversight.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to innovate and develop new AI-enabled tools, frameworks, and ways of working, to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and impact of PAR activities.

What we expect of you

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Basic Qualifications

·Doctorate degree and 2 years of sales, marketing, market access, experience;

· OR master’s degree and 4 years; of sales, marketing, market access, experience;

· OR bachelor’s degree and 6 years; of sales, marketing, market access, experience;

· OR associate’s degree and 10 years; of sales, marketing, market access, experience;

·OR High school diploma or GED and 12 years of sales, marketing, market access, experience;


Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare access and payer landscape, including buy-and-bill and specialty pharmacy models, formulary coverage, utilization management requirements (e.g., prior authorization and step therapy), reimbursement, and patient support services.
  • Experience in marketing, sales, patient access, or a related role in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Proven experience developing and executing marketing programs, customer-facing materials, or field enablement initiatives.
  • Strong ability to synthesize brand priorities, customer and patient insights, market research, field feedback, and performance data into actionable recommendations and effective resources.
  • Experience collaborating with field teams and cross-functional partners, including Brand, Payer, Patient Support, Market Research, and Analytics, with the ability to build alignment and influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Experience working with external agencies and vendors to support the development and execution of marketing initiatives.
  • Experience managing budgets or components of budgets, including tracking spend, prioritizing investments, and resolving issues.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to independently manage multiple workstreams, timelines, and deliverables with attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and effective prompting to improve insight synthesis, content development, and execution efficiency.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex information for different audiences.
  • Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, sound judgment, accountability, and openness to seeking and acting on feedback.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

raw.title: Virtual Practice Admin Specialist - Charm EHR Experience REQUIRED
raw.excerpt: We are seeking an intelligent, articulate, and deeply empathetic Virtual Practice Admin Specialist to run the daily administrative operations and patient engagement for our specialized functional medicine practice.
raw.description:
We are seeking an intelligent, articulate, and deeply empathetic Virtual Practice Admin Specialist to run the daily administrative operations and patient engagement for our specialized functional medicine practice. We need an independent thinker who can view a schedule like a strategic game of Tetris, master our software systems, and connect with our patients with warmth and respect.

In this pivotal position, you will execute our daily workflow "circle"—handling patient communication via phone calls, emails, and portal messages, navigating Charm EHR, managing lab ordering and uploads, processing payments, and strategically maintaining the calendar. The ideal candidate possesses an accent-neutral, polished phone presence, a strong grasp of functional medicine or naturopathic clinic workflows.

Working Environment & Core Schedule

  • Role Title:Virtual Practice Admin Specialist (Functional Medicine)
  • Practice Specialty: Functional Medicine / Naturopathic Care
  • Status: Full-Time (31 Hours / Week)
  • Core Schedule (PST):
    • Monday – Thursday: 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM PST & 1:30 PM – 4:30 PM PST (7 hrs/day)
    • Friday: 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM PST (4 hrs)
    • Off on major holidays and pre-scheduled practice closure dates.
  • Core Systems & Software:Charm EHR (Required), Fullscript, MailChimp, Canva, LabCorp/Quest Portals

Top 3 Daily Tasks

  1. Strategic Calendar & Patient Management: Proactively manage return-visit intervals and appointment lengths according to billing notes. Look 1–2 weeks ahead to align visit timing with lab turnaround schedules so patients remain continuously supported without missing care milestones.
  2. Patient Communication & "Acknowledge and Steer": Triage incoming phone calls, emails, and portal messages. Deliver warm, personal outreach that acknowledges patient requests while guiding them toward optimal appointment and care options.
  3. Daily Administrative "Circle" Execution: Review voicemails/messages, collect payments, process lab downloads/uploads, manage Fullscript order signals, and update MailChimp lists.

Core Responsibilities

  • Phone & Portal Communication: Answer inbound calls and respond to patient inquiries with an accent-neutral, articulate, and empathetic voice. Handle sensitive conversations regarding scheduling, practice policies, and care plans without sounding transactional.
  • Mastery of "Acknowledge and Steer": Connect deeply with patients by validating their concerns or preferences, explaining available scheduling or clinic options clearly, and guiding them to decisions that serve their health journey while maintaining firm practice boundaries.
  • Precision Scheduling & Lab Tracking:
    • Cross-reference billing/encounter notes to execute exact return-visit intervals (e.g., 6–8 weeks) and visit lengths (e.g., 30 vs. 60 minutes).
    • Monitor lab completion timelines (e.g., accounting for 3-week lab turnaround times). Adjust visit lengths or reschedule appointments proactively if labs will not arrive in time, verifying with the provider when needed.
  • Daily Administrative Scope
    • Triage and clear all voicemails, portal messages, and emails
    • Process billing, collect payments, and follow through on task items in billing notes.
    • Download, upload, and link laboratory results (Quest, LabCorp, specialty labs) in Charm EHR.
    • Monitor Fullscript order notifications as outreach triggers, cross-referencing previous encounter notes to send thoughtful, customized check-in notes.
    • Maintain email lists in MailChimp and assist with basic creative or marketing materials in Canva as needed.
  • Independent Problem Solving: Evaluate daily variables—such as lab delays, partial lab completion, or split visits—by referencing clinic guides and cross-checking work independently before escalating issues to the provider.

Requirements

  • Functional/Naturopathic Medicine Tenure: Minimum 2+ years of direct experience supporting a U.S.-based Functional Medicine or Naturopathic medical practice.
  • EHR Proficiency: Direct, hands-on administrative experience navigating Charm EHR (non-negotiable).
  • Communication & Accent: Fluent, highly articulate spoken English with a neutral accent that allows patients to communicate comfortably over the phone.
  • Autonomous Judgment & Problem-Solving: Ability to evaluate clinical/administrative variables, cross-check details independently, and execute complex schedule adjustments without relying on constant oversight.
  • Remote Workspace Setup: Dedicated, private, HIPAA-compliant home office equipped with a reliable computer (PC/Mac), high-speed internet, backup power/internet solutions, and a noise-canceling headset.

Strong Plus Qualifications

  • Practice Tool Stack Experience: Prior experience using Fullscript, MailChimp, Canva, and major laboratory portals (LabCorp, Quest Diagnostics).
  • Growth Potential: Interest in taking on creative projects, marketing materials, and practice expansion tasks once daily operations are mastered.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are a warm, sharp, and intuitive practice manager who genuinely cares for patients. You navigate Charm EHR smoothly, handle calendar logistics with foresight, and possess the communication finesse to guide patients thoughtfully through their functional health journey.

Interested? Click here to apply now!

About the Role:

At TELUS Digital, we help the world’s biggest brands build smarter technology. As a E-commerce Product & Search Relevancy Expert, your mission is to help an AI learn how to suggest the perfect products to online shoppers. You will look at massive catalogs across various industries and decide which items belong together. You act as the "human logic" that ensures a customer sees a matching set or compatible accessories instead of a random, incorrect suggestion.

What You’ll Do:

  • Create Pairs: Match products based on color, pattern, and style so they are visually consistent.

  • Check Compatibility: Ensure products actually work together for the same use case. (Example: Matching the right technical gear for specific sub-disciplines like gravel biking vs. road cycling).

  • Review Metadata: Look at gender, price segment, and seasonality to ensure recommendations are logically and commercially sound.

  • Maintain Data Integrity: Keep a clean, structured list of matches that follow strict brand and category guidelines.

  • Category Research: Quickly learn the nuances of new product domains to pick the best matches. (Example: Researching technical differences in skiing, cycling, or gym fitness gear).

Qualification path

Mandatory Qualifications:

  • Experience: A proven track record in search relevancy, product categorization, or e-commerce content moderation and annotation.

  • Education: A minimum of a Bachelor's in any field.

  • Analytical Skills: The ability to learn and differentiate between technical product categories quickly.

  • Attention to Detail: High sensitivity to visual aesthetics and the ability to spot subtle mismatches in style or price positioning.

  • Efficiency: Comfortable navigating large datasets and high-volume SKU catalogs while maintaining quality standards.

  • English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level to navigate technical documentation and product attributes.

Professional Experience: Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:

  • E-commerce product catalog management or product data analysis.

  • Product recommendations, search relevance, or product matching.

  • Online retail merchandising, product categorization, or taxonomy management.

  • Product compatibility analysis or technical product research.

  • Fashion, sporting goods, consumer electronics, or other product-specific retail domains.

Required Skills:

  • Strong analytical and research skills.

  • Ability to assess product similarity, compatibility and relevance.

  • Attention to detail when reviewing product attributes, metadata and categorization.

  • Ability to interpret product specifications and apply category-specific guidelines.

  • Strong written comprehension and decision-making skills.

Assessment:

In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification.

  • Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts.

  • Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day.

  • Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies.

  • Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects.

  • Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology.

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Über EVOLVE

Wir sind ein ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum. Statt Paid Social nur über die Ad zu betrachten, entwickeln wir starke Neukundenangebote, produzieren die Ads und bauen den Funnel bis zum Kauf. Jedes Angebot rechnen wir auf Deckungsbeitrag durch, damit wir für jeden Kunden das beste Ergebnis erzielen.

Das wirst du tun

  • Kampagnensteuerung: Du planst und steuerst Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, entwickelst skalierbare Strategien für ROAS, POAS und CAC und optimierst sie täglich

  • Skalierung und Profitabilität: Du skalierst Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets, optimierst auf Profitabilität statt auf Ad Spend und bewertest alle Maßnahmen anhand der Performance-Daten

  • Creative und Testing: Du entwickelst mit dem Creative Team Konzepte wie UGC und Founder Ads nach Direct-Response-Prinzipien, bringst sie auch in Advertorial-Copies und Skripte ein, arbeitest eng mit den Copywritern an der Verkaufspsychologie und testest Hooks, Formate und Narrative laufend

  • Kunden: Du analysierst wöchentlich die Kampagnendaten, führst die Kundenreportings und berätst deine Kunden ganzheitlich, nicht nur auf Kanalebene

  • Weiterentwicklung des Bereichs: Du entwickelst Social Ads über SOPs und Qualitätsmanagement weiter und kannst, wenn du möchtest, perspektivisch Verantwortung für das Team übernehmen und es fachlich führen

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen

Du setzt die Richtung für Ads und Funnels und entscheidest, was getestet wird, stehst damit aber nicht allein. Für jeden Schwerpunkt steht dir ein eigener Experte zur Seite: Creative Strategist, Copywriting, Grafik und Video, alle im eigenen Haus.

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Paid-Social-Erfahrung als Hauptkanal, mit nachweisbarer Skalierung von E-Commerce-Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets, dazu ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im Marketing- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, Meta Blueprint ist ein Plus

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Margen, Deckungsbeitrag, Retention, CAC und POAS, mit Praxis darin, aus Daten Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten

  • Praxis in der Kundenführung und in der eigenständigen Betreuung mehrerer Accounts, Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, fließend Englisch, Eigenverantwortung und die Motivation, perspektivisch ein Team zu führen

  • Wöchentliche Team-Recaps und Coffee Chats, damit Remote nicht heißt, den ganzen Tag allein zu arbeiten

Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

This is a remote position.

The Actuarial Analyst II is an experienced individual contributor who performs actuarial analyses supporting Medicare Advantage pricing, forecasting, reserving, risk adjustment, bid development, and financial performance management. The role independently manages defined analyses and workstreams, develops reliable models and reporting, and translates quantitative findings into clear recommendations for actuarial leadership and cross-functional partners. This position works closely with Finance, Product, Network, Operations, and clinical or risk-adjustment teams to identify financial risks, opportunities, and emerging trends.

General Duties/Responsibilities (May include but are not limited to):

  • Develop and maintain actuarial analyses, models, and reporting that support pricing, forecasting, reserving, risk adjustment, and financial planning decisions.
  • Analyze claims, utilization, membership, risk scores, provider performance, and benefit experience to identify financial trends, risks, opportunities, and key drivers.
  • Prepare defined components of Medicare Advantage bid submissions, actuarial exhibits, and supporting documentation in accordance with established methodologies and regulatory guidance.
  • Perform monthly and quarterly reserve, accrual, and financial-performance analyses; validate results, reconcile data, and explain material variances.
  • Evaluate the financial impact of product, benefit, network, operational, and regulatory changes, and communicate implications to business partners.
  • Build and improve repeatable actuarial models, tools, dashboards, controls, and documentation using sound data-management, validation, and version-control practices.
  • Present analysis, assumptions, results, and recommendations to actuarial leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in a clear, concise, and audience-appropriate manner.
  • Provide technical guidance and quality-review support to less experienced analysts, as assigned, while continuing to develop subject-matter expertise.
  • Participate fully in the Actuarial Development Program by pursuing actuarial examinations, completing development activities, incorporating feedback, and applying new knowledge to work assignments.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently organize and complete defined analyses, validate outputs, identify issues, and communicate findings.
  • Experience partnering with nontechnical stakeholders to explain quantitative results and support decisions.

Education/Licensure:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or related quantitative field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must actively participate in the Actuarial Development Program
  • Successfully passed 2-4 actuarial examinations
  • Actuarial modeling, forecasting, and financial analysis
  • Healthcare cost, utilization, membership, and risk-adjustment analytics
  • Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management

raw.description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Real Estate Valuation Specialist within PNC's Real Estate Valuation organization, you will be remote. This is a remote position. Work may be performed from a quiet, confidential space in a home location, approved by PNC. This position may not be available in all geographic locations.

• Highly proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, with advanced skills in Excel and Word
• Knowledge of appraisal methodologies, including valuation principles, review processes, and industry best practices, preferred.This position may be eligible for remote work in select geographic locations, subject to approval by PNC. If approved, work must be conducted from a quiet, secure, and confidential home-based workspace. Occasional in-office participation may be required based on business needs.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Performs real estate valuation administrative/compliance reviews and appraisal revalidations in accordance with PNC Real Estate Appraisal Policy/Procedures, Federal appraisal regulations, and USPAP.
  • Performs real estate valuation administrative/compliance reviews and appraisal revalidations.
  • Performs market research/special projects as needed.
  • Provides recommended changes to an appraiser's approval status for the Appraisers/Evaluators.
  • Completes revalidation Market Survey for PNC Markets.
  • Lead staff training sessions.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

  • Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  • Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Preferred Skills

Analytical Thinking, Commercial Real Estate, Competitive Advantages, Consumer Lending, Credit Risk Management, Data Analytics, Decision Making, Financial Operations, Portfolio Risk, Risk Appetite

Competencies

Conflict Management, Core Application Systems, Problem Solving, Real Estate Appraisal, Real Estate Appraisal Standard Operating Procedures, Real Estate Valuation Auditing, Real Estate Valuation Quality Assurance

Work Experience

Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree with < 1 year of professional experience and/or successful completion of a formal development program. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

Education

Bachelors

Certifications

No Required Certification(s)

Licenses

No Required License(s)

Language Assessments

No Required or Preferred Language Assessments

Pay Transparency

Base Salary: $63,750.00 – $127,500.00Salaries may vary based on geographic location, market data and on individual skills, experience, and education.

Application Window

Generally, this opening is expected to be posted for two business days from 10/20/2026, although it may be longer with business discretion.

Benefits

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

To learn more about these and other programs, including benefits for full time and part-time employees, visit .

Please include “accommodation request” in the subject line title and be sure to include your name, the job ID, and your preferred method of contact in the body of the email. Emails not related to accommodation requests will not receive responses. Applicants may also call 877-968-7762 and say "Workday" for accommodation assistance. All information provided will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

At PNC we foster an inclusive and accessible workplace. We provide reasonable accommodations to employment applicants and qualified individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their positions.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)

PNC provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other categories protected by law.

This position is subject to the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA) and, for any registered role, the Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act of 2008 (SAFE Act) and/or the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), which prohibit the hiring of individuals with certain criminal history.

California Residents

raw.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Operations team

The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About the role

Affirm’s mission is to deliver honest financial products to improve lives. We do this by partnering with top companies to offer responsible financial products at the point of sale. Working jointly with our clients, Affirm co-develops and executes on joint partnership strategies to innovate and grow the business.

We are seeking a Partner Manager to lead performance and transformation across our global BPO vendor network. This role is accountable for driving vendor excellence and customer satisfaction at scale, while also shaping long-term vendor strategy and leading large cross-functional initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring both vendor/BPO management expertise, and the analytical capability to validate, interpret, and act on data, enabling better decisions and driving change at scale.

This is a senior leadership role within Operations, with direct accountability for outcomes across multiple functional areas, across customer needs and requiring significant strategic oversight, cross-functional leadership, and sharp analytical judgement.

What you’ll do

  • Own vendor performance, including customer experience, service-levels, compliance, and QA outcomes.
  • Lead executive-level vendor governance (e.g. QBRs, escalations).
  • Define operational strategies for horizontal services across the vendor network.
  • Partner with the Business Analyst team to shape what metrics and dashboards are needed to run the business.
  • Use data to diagnose performance gaps, validate trends, and prioritize interventions.
  • Run ad-hoc analyses and scenario modeling to support rapid decision-making.
  • Support Strategic Partnerships by serving as entry point and liaison for unique partner operational needs.
  • Lead initiatives that require coordination across Operations, Compliance, Product, Risk, Training, QA, and WFM.
  • Translate vendor insights into cross-functional actions that improve customer experience and compliance outcomes.
  • Act as senior escalation point for systemic issues.
  • Drive key initiatives such as product/process rollouts, vendor migrations, or regulatory implementations.
  • Design and execute structured change programs, ensuring vendor readiness and sustained adoption.
  • Champion continuous improvement and innovation across the vendor network.

What we look for

  • 8+ years of expertise in vendor/BPO management, operations, or related fields
  • Strong analytical background with the ability to define the right questions, work with analysts to build the right tools, and run independent analysis when needed.
  • Proven ability to drive vendor accountability through scorecards, governance, and structured interventions.
  • Track record of leading large, cross-functional programs with measurable business impact.
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills with internal and vendor executives.
  • Experience managing vendor networks of 2,000+ agents across multiple geographies (preferred).
  • Industry background in fintech, technology, or high-growth customer operations (preferred).
  • Knowledge of compliance-heavy functions (Fraud, Payments, Compliance) (preferred).
  • Skilled at turning complex data into clear narratives for senior leadership (preferred).

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $128,000 - $188,000

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

* RECRUITING FOR THE FUTURE. This posting is for a future job opportunity. If you don't see anything posted that interests you right now, submit your resume and we can keep you in mind for future opportunities. Please note that only those who qualify will be contacted.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Ensures timely contract review to meet the needs of the business units;
  • Prepares, reviews and interprets contracts for adequacy, appropriateness and completeness in terms of indemnity, liability, confidentiality, intellectual property, payment terms, and any other applicable issues that may pose legal or business risk, confirming that all Innomar/ABC processes and requirements are adhered to;

  • Work with all functional corporate, divisional and regional subject matter experts (Business Units, Operations, Legal, Finance, and IT) to provide content and context response integrity for consistency, reliability and most up-to-data material used in responses to customer requests for contracts, information requests and presentations as applicable.
  • Works with performance-based compliance tools, reports and scorecard to provide the organization with information on compliance monitoring and contract performance.

  • Provides the "order entry" function as it relates to executed agreements.
  • Works with and assists with the development of content library loading process in the corporate database programs.
  • Must be willing to do minimal travel as required.
  • Performs related duties as assigned.

Experience and Educational Requirements:


  • Requires training and understanding in fields such as business administration, accountancy, legal, sales, marketing, computer sciences or similar vocations generally obtained through completion of a four year
  • Bachelor's Degree Program or comparable on the job training and work responsibilities in administrative duties; requires direct experience in contracting environment of at least three - five (3-5) years.

Minimum Skills, Knowledge and Ability Requirements:


  • Understands the legal and health system trends and operating assumptions
  • Legal background - 1 to 2 years work experience as law clerk/training/certification preferred but not required
  • Works independently and can confidently manage negotiations
  • Providing advice to Operations and staff to drive performance, compliance of contracts
  • Experience in drafting and reviewing contracts
  • Analytical skills relative to contract information and related matters
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Ability to balance business objectives and opportunities against legal and other risk/requirements
  • “Can do” attitude and customer-service orientation
  • Keen attention to detail, with an ability to spot issues and/or errors
  • Ability to multi-task; strong time-management skills and a proven ability to work efficiently
  • Ability to thrive in a high-pressure environment; comfortable working with tight deadlines
  • Strong presentation and communication skills
  • Excellent integration and implementation skills
  • Excellent internal skills
  • Working knowledge of computers and software programs necessary to operate effectively with company systems and programs, especially Excel.

This posting is intended to fill an existing vacancy for our Senior Contract Specialist role

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more.

Full time

Therefore, harassment is prohibited and all matters related to recruiting, training, compensation, benefits, promotions and transfers comply with equal opportunity principles and are non-discriminatory.

If you wish to request an accommodation while seeking employment, please call 888.692.2272 or email . We will make accommodation determinations on a request-by-request basis. raw.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Senior Project Control Analyst to provide financial analysis, project controls, reporting, and contract-administration support for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Project Control Analyst to provide financial analysis, project controls, reporting, and contract-administration support for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role manages and analyzes funding, invoicing, expenditures, burn rates, estimates at completion, spend plans, tools, travel, other direct costs, and related contract-financial data.

The Senior Project Control Analyst will support SAM.gov service-contract reporting, monitor funding and expenditures by Contract Line Item Number, develop financial information for Monthly Status Reports and Program Management Reviews, and maintain accurate data for program dashboards and approval workflows. This position will work closely with program leadership, contracts, finance, task leads, subcontractors, and Government stakeholders to promote accurate forecasting, compliant invoicing, and timely financial decision-making.

This position is remote, with preference given to candidates located in or near Chicago.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Project Control Analyst will:

  • Prepare and maintain annual service-contract labor reporting data for submission through SAM.gov, including applicable subcontractor labor.
  • Monitor task order funding, expenditures, commitments, and available balances by CLIN, contract period, task, and cost category.
  • Develop and maintain budget-versus-actual analyses, burn-rate calculations, forecasts, and estimates at completion.
  • Prepare spend plans, funding-status reports, financial dashboards, and other decision-support products for program leadership.
  • Develop financial inputs for Monthly Status Reports, Program Management Reviews, Project Management Plan updates, and other recurring program deliverables.
  • Track planned and actual expenditures and identify funding, schedule, or performance variances requiring management attention.
  • Prepare draft invoice backup documentation and reconcile supporting data before submission for Government review and approval.
  • Validate invoice charges against the applicable contract period, CLIN, labor category, rate, quantity, and supporting documentation.
  • Support electronic invoice preparation and submission through the Government-designated invoicing system.
  • Track current-period and cumulative invoicing, subcontracted amounts, billed costs, remaining balances, and final-invoice status.
  • Maintain detailed tracking for tools, travel, and other direct costs, including purchase documentation, approvals, incurred costs, and cumulative amounts invoiced.
  • Support Requests to Initiate Purchase, Consent to Purchase requests, and Travel Authorization Requests.
  • Track whether proposed purchases are commercial or non-commercial items or services and maintain supporting commerciality records.
  • Coordinate with contracts, accounting, finance, procurement, task leads, and subcontractors to validate financial data and resolve discrepancies.
  • Maintain financial data supporting Task Order Management Portal dashboards, management reports, and approval workflows.
  • Establish and maintain consistent financial-control procedures, templates, logs, and reconciliation processes.
  • Support funding and financial-data transitions during transition-in and transition-out activities.
  • Analyze financial trends and communicate potential funding shortfalls, overruns, underruns, invoicing delays, and other risks to program leadership.
  • Maintain organized, complete, and auditable financial records in accordance with contract and company requirements.
  • Protect sensitive Government, corporate, personnel, and financial information.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of relevant professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in project controls, program finance, financial planning and analysis, contract finance, accounting, or a related discipline.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, federal civilian, or other Government contracts.
  • Experience monitoring funding and expenditures by CLIN, task, contract period, or cost category.
  • Experience developing budgets, forecasts, burn-rate analyses, estimates at completion, variance analyses, and spend plans.
  • Experience preparing financial inputs for Monthly Status Reports, Program Management Reviews, or comparable executive-level reports.
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, reconciling, or supporting Government contract invoices and invoice backup documentation.
  • Experience with firm-fixed-price, fixed-price-award-fee, cost-reimbursable, tools, travel, or other direct cost CLINs.
  • Experience with SAM.gov service-contract reporting.
  • Experience with Government invoicing or acquisition systems, including ASSIST or comparable platforms.
  • Experience supporting travel authorizations, purchase requests, consent-to-purchase requests, and commerciality tracking.
  • Experience coordinating financial data with contracts, accounting, procurement, task leads, subcontractors, and Government stakeholders.
  • Experience maintaining financial information in program-management portals, dashboards, or automated approval workflows.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data validation, reconciliation, and financial modeling.
  • Experience with Power BI, SharePoint, Deltek Costpoint, Unanet, Microsoft Project, or comparable financial, reporting, and collaboration tools.
  • Knowledge of federal contracting, funding controls, invoicing requirements, indirect costs, and financial-record retention.
  • Familiarity with earned value concepts and project-performance measurement.
  • CPA, CMA, Certified Government Financial Manager, Earned Value Professional, PMP, or a comparable financial or project-controls certification.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, reconciliation, and forecasting abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, data integrity, and documentation quality.
  • Ability to explain complex financial information clearly to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple reporting cycles, deadlines, and approval workflows.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining accountability, discretion, and consistent follow-through.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

raw.excerpt: Join Axon and be a Force for Good. At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life.
raw.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

About Axon 911

Axon 911 brings together Prepared and Carbyne under Axon. Together, we are creating the only platform that combines modern 911 infrastructure with an AI intelligence layer—helping public safety agencies move faster, make better decisions, and deliver better outcomes in the moments that matter most.

911 is the backbone of public safety, yet the professionals behind it have long been held back by outdated technology. Axon 911 is here to change that. Joining this team means more than taking a job—it means helping shape the future of emergency response and building a safer, more connected world.

Your Impact

The Director of Public Safety at Axon 911 will be a strategic leader, advisor, and collaborator, responsible for driving initiatives that align Axon 911’s solutions with the evolving needs of the public safety community. This role involves deep engagement with internal teams and external stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency, increase market penetration, and position Axon 911 as a thought leader in the public safety sector.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Leadership & Team Management Lead Axon 911’s public safety strategy, strengthen industry partnerships (NENA/APCO), mentor the Public Safety team, and drive KPIs, scalability, innovation, and long-term growth.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Engagement Partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success to align solutions with customer needs, improve onboarding/training, and drive adoption across high-value public safety customers.

Product Strategy, AI Initiatives & Market Feedback Gather customer feedback to influence product enhancements, prioritize AI-related initiatives, coordinate early-access programs, and ensure solutions meet operational needs within public safety organizations.

Sales Enablement, Advocacy & Industry Presence Support market expansion and deal strategy through industry expertise, customer relationships, speaking engagements, workshops, webinars, thought leadership, and strategic go-to-market initiatives.

Operational Excellence & Business Impact Optimize workflows and processes while driving measurable outcomes tied to customer satisfaction, retention, product adoption, strategic partnerships, lead generation, industry engagement, and cross-functional business improvements.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership and managerial experience within public safety, emergency communications, or PSAP operations, including experience serving at the Deputy Director level or above (or equivalent senior leadership role).
  • Deep expertise across PSAP operations, NG911, CAD, emergency communications workflows, and evolving public safety technology trends.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with PSAP leaders, industry associations (NENA/APCO), executive stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong strategic leadership experience driving scalable programs, operational improvements, and cross-functional initiatives in complex environments.
  • Ability to translate customer feedback, operational challenges, and market insights into actionable product, business, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and customer engagement skills, including executive presentations, workshops, industry events, and consultative sales support.
  • Collaborative, data-driven mindset with experience defining KPIs, measuring success, and driving continuous improvement in fast-paced, mission-critical environments.

Work Location

This position is fully remote within a specified territory, requiring up to 50% of travel for on-site client engagement, educational workshops, and representing the organization at major professional conferences.

  • Candidates based within the Pacific timezone are highly encouraged to apply.

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
  • Discretionary paid time off
  • Paid parental leave for all
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans
  • Fitness Programs
  • Emotional & Mental Wellness Support
  • Learning & Development programs
  • And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Pay Transparency:

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, annual performance-related bonus, and stock awards. The starting base pay for this role is between USD $108,000.00 in the lowest geographic market and USD $181,750.00 in the highest geographic market. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially, and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings, please visit

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes
