raw.title: Data Governance Analyst
raw.excerpt: Data IdeologyAt DI, we provide Data & Analytics expertise to drive measurable business outcomes, often solving complex business problems for our clients.
raw.description:
Data Ideology

At DI, we provide Data & Analytics expertise to drive measurable business outcomes, often solving complex business problems for our clients. Our data analytics advisory services enable our customers to transform data into insights by driving a culture of empowerment and ownership of results. Our team consists of highly motivated individuals passionate about learning, understanding, collaborating, and intellectually curious. For more information about Data Ideology, visit

Data Governance Analyst

We are seeking a hands-on Data Governance Analyst to operate at the intersection of data governance, analytics, technology, and the business. This is not a policy-only governance role. The ideal candidate will work directly with business and technology stakeholders to understand data, document and improve how it is governed, analyze issues, and turn governance objectives into practical solutions.The right person will be comfortable moving between stakeholder conversations, data definitions, data quality, metadata, SQL-based analysis, reporting, and governance processes.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will help the organization make its data more:

  • Trusted
  • Understandable
  • Consistent
  • Accessible to the right people
  • Measurable
  • Governed in a practical, usable way

They should be able to take an ambiguous data problem, work with stakeholders to understand it, dig into the underlying data where necessary, and drive the issue toward resolution.For more information about Data Ideology, visit www.dataideology.com

Responsibilities
To perform in this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. Other duties may be assigned to meet business needs.

  • Partner with business, data, technology, and governance stakeholders to identify and address data governance needs.
  • Facilitate conversations with data owners and subject-matter experts to establish definitions, ownership, standards, and appropriate usage of data.
  • Support development and maintenance of business glossaries, data dictionaries, metadata, data standards, and governance documentation.
  • Assist with data quality initiatives by identifying, analyzing, documenting, and helping remediate data issues.
  • Perform hands-on data analysis using SQL or similar tools to investigate governance and data-quality questions.
  • Analyze datasets to validate business rules, definitions, completeness, consistency, and accuracy.
  • Help translate business requirements into measurable data rules and governance requirements.
  • Support data access, sharing, and usage-governance processes.
  • Build or maintain reporting, dashboards, or metrics that provide visibility into data quality and governance activities.
  • Work across teams to improve governance workflows and reduce manual or inefficient processes.
  • Communicate findings clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Help move governance initiatives from discussion and documentation into repeatable operational processes.

Supervisory Responsibilities: None

Qualifications

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field required. Advanced degree preferred.

  • Approximately 2–5 years of experience in data governance, data analytics, business/data analysis, or a related discipline.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders, data owners, technical teams, or senior leadership.

  • Strong Plus

  • Experience in banking, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience with enterprise data governance or data-quality platforms.
  • Familiarity with Informatica or comparable governance/data-quality tooling.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms or modern data environments.
  • Experience automating data, reporting, or governance workflows.
  • Exposure to master data management, customer data, hierarchy management, or enterprise metadata.
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Data governance
    • Data quality
    • Metadata and data definitions
    • Data ownership/stewardship
    • Data access and usage
  • Hands-on SQL experience and the ability to investigate and analyze data independently.
  • Experience with reporting or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to translate between business requirements and technical/data concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Organized, curious, analytical, and comfortable in environments where not every requirement is initially defined.

The strongest candidate will have the technical aptitude to investigate data independently while remaining comfortable working directly with business stakeholders.

Work Environment:

  • Remote work from home.
  • Hours of work and days are generally Monday through Friday. Specific business hours will depend on client needs.

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
  • The person in this position must occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, library stacks, office machinery, etc.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and printer.
  • The person in this position frequently communicates with clients and coworkers. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

Data Ideology is an EEO Employer

raw.description:
Applicants must be a resident and work from one of the following states: WA, OR, OH, IL, MN, NC, SC, FL, AZ, TX, or ID with occasional travel to our headquarters, located in Seattle, WA.

Who We Are:

At PEMCO, we’re all about people – our customers, our employees, and the community. We’re a mutual insurance company owned by our Northwest policyholders. We provide auto, home, renters, and boat coverage. Recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Insurance Companies in both Auto and Home for 2026, based on customer survey feedback, and by Newsweek as one of America’s Greatest Midsize Workplaces 2025. We are consistently recognized for our outstanding customer service, employee expertise, community partnerships, and social impact programs. All of which makes PEMCO a great place to work!

Our social impact programs motivate high achievement by youth in education; build stronger and greener communities; and increase safety at home, on the road, and at play. We’re committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and to fostering an inspiring and inclusive workplace. These efforts create and cultivate an environment that builds fairness and understanding, encourages collaboration and flexibility, and celebrates all the ways in which we’re different and the same – enabling all individuals to achieve their full potential.

Why We Need You:

The Senior Data Scientist - Actuarial position is responsible for conducting complex actuarial and predictive analysis to support product development, rating, reserving, process improvements and system changes for PEMCO.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Independently perform complex analytical support for actuarial and product development.
  • Develop large-scale predictive modeling and multivariate analysis.
  • Create queries and tools to assist the development and implementation of rates, rating plans, pricing strategies and financial analysis.
  • Participate with product managers and actuaries in making strategic decisions.
  • Collaborate with Product Team and other business units to provide business solutions.
  • Develop and document system workflows and business processes.
  • Pioneer best practice in building tools and processes to create efficiencies.
  • Mentor less experienced members, helping them improve and sharpen their skills by sharing best practices.
  • Demonstrate behaviors consistent with PEMCO's policies, values, code of ethics and business conduct.
  • Authentically support the PEMCO Brand and constantly are on the lookout for top talent to join us to achieve our Mission to Worry Less and Live More.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You'll Bring:

  • B.A. or B.S. degree or equivalent work experience (Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics or related field) is required
  • Graduate or other professional degree or equivalent work experience is preferred
  • 6+ years of experience in actuarial and statistical predictive modeling is required — Proven knowledge of HR industry practices
  • 3+ years of experience in the property and casualty insurance industry is required
  • MS Office: Skilled proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook is required
  • Job specific: Proficiency in Python, R, SAS and/or SQL
  • Job specific: Proficiency with Radar, Emblem, or ResQ
  • Job specific: Must be able to demonstrate high level of skill in quantitative modeling, knowledge of data structures and ability to write complex SQL queries is required
  • Precision: Is detail orientated and has a strong desire for accuracy and thoroughness is required
    Analytical and data-driven: Thinks analytically; a structured thinker who can put complex ideas into clear frameworks; uses data to conduct root cause analysis and develops high quality, consumable, and consistent metrics that drive strategic objectives and priorities is required
  • Highly Analytical: Is passionate about working with disparate datasets bringing data together to answer business questions. Collaborates to create, manage, and translate data to meaningful insights. Can work with external vendors to integrate data for analysis; knows how to build efficient and scalable infrastructure and data models
  • Compliance: Possesses knowledge and understanding of relevant laws, rules, and regulations is required
  • Problem Solver: Ability to analyze, diagnose and resolve complex unstructured problems quickly, efficiently, and collaboratively
  • Communicator: Communicates clearly and informatively, verbally and in writing, with colleagues, customers, and the community in both technical and non-technical professional language
  • Independent: Is highly self-motivated and directed. Demonstrates the ability to work with limited direction, communicates relevant information to the appropriate levels during times of uncertainty
  • Organized: Has excellent time management skills and easily manages multiple tasks, activities, and projects
  • Presenter: Organizes data visually and speaks clearly and persuasively in group presentations and meetings with multiple peer groups and senior management

Compensation:

The pay range for this role is shown below. Compensation decisions are determined based on an individual’s qualifications, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

  • Greater Seattle area target pay range: $154,845 - $189,255. The full pay range is $129,038 - $215,063.
  • Outside Greater Seattle area target pay range: $136,654 - $167,022. The full pay range is $113,879 - $189,797.

Greater Seattle Area is defined as working within approximately 100 miles of Seattle.
Outside Greater Seattle is defined as working approximately 100 miles or more from Seattle.

Benefits:

Regular part-time PEMCO employees working at least 24 hours per week and regular full-time PEMCO employees are eligible to elect coverage under medical, dental, and vision plans for themselves and their eligible family members with generous employer premium cost shares. In addition, as a benefits-eligible employee, you are:

  • covered by employer-paid basic life and accidental death & dismemberment insurance policies as well as long- and short-term disability benefit coverages.
  • eligible to participate in PEMCO’s 401(k) plan, which includes a generous employer match (2 for 1 on the first 6% employee pre-tax and/or Roth deferral, up to federal maximums).

PEMCO provides the following paid leave programs for benefits-eligible employees in their first year of PEMCO employment:

  • Vacation and eight (8) paid holidays.
  • Granted four (4) floating holidays and up to ten (10) days of sick leave immediately upon hire (pro-rated based on hire date and full-time/part-time status).
  • In addition, PEMCO provides paid time off for bereavement, jury duty, and employee volunteering in the community.

Other miscellaneous benefit programs offered by PEMCO include:

  • Education Assistance Program after one year of service.
  • Scholarship program for children of PEMCO employees after one year of service; children’s birthday gift program
  • Flexible Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Program, and charitable gift matching

Other compensation depending on role, contributions, and performance may include:

  • Discretionary bonuses.
  • Tiered sales commissions and/or incentives

Equal Employment Opportunity:

At PEMCO, we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our products, and our community to flourish. PEMCO is honored to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, or veteran status.

Accommodations

At PEMCO, people are at the heart of our business. We’re committed to providing an inclusive hiring experience for all candidates. If you need reasonable accommodations to apply for a role or participate in an interview, please contact us by email with your name, the job reference number(s), your preferred contact method, and a brief description of the accommodation needed. Requests are considered on a case by case basis in accordance with applicable disability laws, including the ADAAA.

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws:

  • Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)
  • Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)
  • Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA)

raw.title: Events Specialist
raw.excerpt: We're looking for someone to run our international conference programme and exhibitions, as well as our own customer events and webinars.
raw.description:
We're looking for someone to run our international conference programme and exhibitions, as well as our own customer events and webinars. Full-time, permanent, UK-based, and fully remote.

Salary £30,000 - £40,000 (depending on experience).

Closing date: Sunday 8th November

Industry: Education and Software, with a focus on medical and health professional education.

Why this role exists

Our customers rely on the risr/ platform to deliver high-stakes and workplace-based assessments that really matter to institutions, professionals, and ultimately patient care.

Events are one of the main ways we meet leads and key decision-makers at organisations we want to work with, and stay close to the customers we have. In 2026, that means around 25 conferences and exhibitions across the UK, Europe, North America, and Australia; our own community days and customer events in each region; and a regular programme of webinars and user groups. Many of these are planned a year or more ahead.

This role exists to give every one of those events a single owner, from first booking to final report. Nothing slips, every deadline is met, and our go-to-market team can focus on conversations rather than logistics.

The role at a glance

As our Events Specialist, you’ll own the delivery of every risr/ event: international conferences and exhibitions, our own in-person community days and customer events, and our webinars and online events.

Our go-to-market team (marketing, business development and account management) decides which events we attend and what we want from them, and you make them happen. You’ll book the space, manage the suppliers, meet every exhibitor deadline, get the right people and materials to the right place, and report back on each event's costs and outcomes.

Most of the work is done remotely from the UK. You’ll attend some UK events in person, and occasionally travel overseas, to see how our events run on the ground and to understand the market and our competitors.

You might currently be an events manager, events executive or conference coordinator. What matters is that you’ve run events from start to finish.

Requirements

Responsibilities

Conferences and exhibitions

  • Turn the go-to-market team’s event decisions into one clear, shared events calendar, planned far enough ahead to secure good space and rates.
  • Book exhibition space, sponsorships, and memberships, and track the contracts, payment dates, and deadlines that come with them.
  • Own the exhibitor portal for every event, ensuring insurance documents, risk assessments, company information, branding, and team registrations are submitted on time.
  • Book stand furniture, power, AV and any other on-site services.
  • Arrange shipping of stand kit and materials, including customs requirements for events outside the UK.
  • Work with the regional marketing leads to order print and collateral, so the right materials arrive in the right place.
  • Coordinate speaking slots with organisers, including abstracts, slide decks and speaker details, so submissions are made on time.
  • Put together a detailed briefing on the event schedule, exhibit hours, contact details, the leads form link, and exhibitor and sponsor information in a team document, including clear goals and outcomes, and review it in a pre- and post-event call.
  • Build strong relationships with event organisers, so we hear about opportunities early and maintain good terms on sponsorships.

risr/-hosted events

  • Plan and deliver our in-person community days, customer lunches, workshops and showcases in each region, working with the regional marketing lead.
  • Find, compare and book venues, and organise catering, AV and accessibility needs.
  • Manage registrations, prepare attendee communications, and coordinate on-the-day logistics.
  • Order and coordinate the print and delivery of event materials and services.
  • Manage event resources and materials

Webinars and online events

  • Set up and run logistics for webinars, user groups, and online events in Zoom, including registration, reminders, and recordings.
  • Act as the main logistics contact for external speakers.
  • Share registrant lists with the regional marketing lead for follow-up.

Planning, reporting and improvement

  • Set up and manage each event as a project in monday.com, so everyone involved knows what’s due and when, and follow up on anything outstanding.
  • Record the spend on every event in one place, so the team can see what each one costs.
  • Run a short review after each major event: what it cost, who we met, what worked and what to change.
  • Keep our event checklists, processes and supplier contacts written down and up to date, so every event gets easier to run.

What success looks like

  • Every exhibitor deadline, portal submission and registration is met, without last-minute scrambles.
  • The team arrives at every event with the stand, materials, bookings and briefing they need, and can focus on networking.
  • Spend is recorded for every event, so the go-to-market team can compare what each event cost with what it delivered.
  • Leads from every event are in the CRM within a week of the event closing.
  • We complete a short review after every major event, and what we learn shapes the next one.
  • The go-to-market team trusts that if an event is on the calendar, you'll handle it.

Who we are looking for

We’re more interested in how you think and work than ticking every box, but experience that will help you succeed includes:

Essential

  • At least 3 years' experience organising events from start to finish, ideally as an exhibitor at conferences or exhibitions, not only as the host or venue.
  • Excellent organisation, with the ability to manage many events at once, each at a different stage and with its own deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail. You spot missing forms before they become a problem.
  • Confidence in building relationships with organisers, venues and suppliers, and with colleagues across different teams and time zones.
  • A calm, structured approach to solving problems when plans change.
  • Experience running webinars or online events in Zoom or a similar platform.
  • The ability to communicate clearly and confidently in written and spoken English.
  • The ability to work autonomously while collaborating openly with others.
  • A curious, practical relationship with AI. You try things, keep what works, and build it into how you actually work.

Desirable

  • Experience organising international events, including shipping, customs or travel logistics.
  • Experience with B2B, SaaS, education or healthcare events.
  • Experience with event registration or digital events platforms.
  • Experience using tools such as monday.com, a CRM, or similar platforms.

About us

The risr/ mission is to provide technology to enable every ambition.

The risr/ platform enables doctors, dentists, nurses, and other health professionals to apply and pay for assessments, be assessed effectively, and advance through their courses and training programmes so they can ultimately provide high-quality patient care and promote health.

Our software and services help institutions, such as Awarding Bodies, Universities and Postgraduate Specialty Medical Colleges, achieve digital transformation of assessment processes, for example, written and practical exams and workplace-based assessments.

We are growing rapidly in international markets in Australia, Canada, Asia, Ireland and beyond. For example, over 60% of doctors in the UK are assessed using risr/ products.

What you can expect at risr/

We keep things brutally simple; we are natural-born collaborators; we’re hungry for innovation; and we always do the right thing - even if it’s harder or requires us to go the extra mile.

As we continue to grow, some business travel will be required to meet our customers in person and nurture strong, effective relationships.

Due to the nature of our work and having teams based in multiple time zones, there will be a requirement for the successful applicant to work outside of regular office hours, in the evening / early mornings or on the weekend. We take care to ensure team members are not required to do this regularly, and with our flexible working arrangements, our team manages their regular working time around any out-of-hours work that may be required.

Benefits

Our people enjoy a very high level of trust, autonomy, flexibility and transparency, including:

  • Work from home, at a co-working space or set up an office near your home.
  • Freedom to choose your equipment and training as you see fit.
  • Freedom from corporate bureaucracy, which slows people down and stops them from giving their best.
  • Access to open-book finances: everyone in the company knows our income, outgoings, what we have in the bank and everyone’s salary.
  • A generous salary, benefits package (including enhanced parental leave policies based on length of service) and participation in profit share.
  • A Health and Wellbeing Allowance of £1,200 per annum.
  • Confidential mental health support
  • Electric vehicle scheme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • risr/ pays for your internet.
  • risr/ pays for a mobile phone and contract.
  • risr/ provides genuinely flexible working and autonomy.
  • risr/ allows you to set your working routine to suit you based on your role and team.
  • risr/ has no defined maximum holiday allowance - you are free to manage your own time.
  • Participation in risr/ profit share. 25% of the profits risr/ makes is split equally between the risr/ employees.

How we hire

We want to make sure we're a great fit for each other! Here is a breakdown of our application and interview process:

  • Application Review: Submit your application by 8th November 2026. Our team will review your application. If we believe you have what we're looking for, we'll invite you to the next stage. We'll send Stage 1 invitations by 13th November 2026.
  • Stage 1: The Intro (Remote): A quick video submission answering a few questions on your own time. Submit these by 19th November. We will send invitations for Stage 2 by 26th November 2026.
  • Stage 2: The Group Collaboration (Remote): A practical team interview with other candidates. Save the date: This will take place on 3rd December 2026 from 2 pm to 4 pm GMT.
  • Stage 3: The Deep Dive (Remote): An interview with some of the team you will work alongside to discuss your skills and goals in more detail. These interviews will take place from 7 to 9 December 2026.
  • Stage 4: The Final Meetup (In-Person): A face-to-face meeting with some of our UK-based team members in the week beginning 14th December 2026.

If you believe this is the role for you, please continue filling out the application form. Please note that we want to hear from you as an individual when you are applying to work at risr/, and all content in your application should be original and your own. We will only consider applications with a cover letter.

Come and join us – we promise you won’t have worked for a company quite like it!

risr/ is an equal opportunities employer, and we do not exclude people on the grounds of sex, gender preference or reassignment, pregnancy, parental status, race, marital / relationship status, disability, age, religion, belief or sexual orientation.

Who is RTS:

Recycle Track Systems (RTS) was developed with a desire to do better. We are committed to evolving and challenging the waste industry to be better stewards of the environment. We utilize technology, data analytics, sustainability expertise, and operational excellence to help people and businesses incorporate sustainability into their daily routines. Our passion for sustainability and innovation allows for us to guide businesses to a future of reaching a goal of zero waste.

Our technology platform utilizes sensors, GPS tracking, and highly engaged partner haulers to provide waste management and recycling services and track materials from their source to recycling and composting facilities. Our sustainability experts analyze the data generated by the platform to help our customers make tangible improvements to their waste management and recycling efforts. Ultimately, we are innovating to treat waste as a component material for other products in the circular economy so that as little as possible is deposited into landfills or incinerators.

What we need:

This position is a customer and hauling partner approach, excelling not only in the delivery of outstanding client support to both internal and external clients but also in actively executing functions related to account management, procurement, and processing service requests within our customer's processes. Your pivotal role involves managing the entire customer life cycle to ensure business retention. The team oversees a book of business, aiming to establish long-term partnerships and improve profit margins for both customers and vendors. Leveraging strategic thinking, the team maximizes operational efficiencies internally and externally by analyzing data to implement predictive solutions for our customers. The overarching goal is to enhance sustainability while elevating the overall customer and vendor experience.

Schedule Requirement
Rotating weekend schedule. Flexibility and consistency are important to support both customer and operational needs.

This position is remote and available to candidates residing in the following states: Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, Tennessee, and Virginia.

 

What People say about You:

You excel at independently solving problems within a team environment, ensuring a high-quality experience for both customers and vendors. Your flexibility and openness to change are crucial as our business expands, and your willingness to contribute innovative thoughts and ideas will significantly influence both internal teams and external customers. Given the unique nature of this position, you are adaptable, allowing you to cultivate and enhance your skills across various domains, particularly in account management, procurement, and client support.

 

What you will be doing:

  • Effectively Manage and grow Book of Business in the Strategic Partnership Team.
  • Ensuring retention metrics and customers remain under long-term contracts.
  • Generating new opportunities within existing customer network for new sites, adding new services for existing customers.
  • Attending sales meetings and conducting business reviews with Key Accounts regularly.
  • Ensure daily use of CRM for customer activities and sales pipeline management.
  • Using customer and prospect CRM management software and updating relevant information held in these systems daily.
  • Monitor customer activity and proactively make recommendations for service changes or other solutions to better meet their needs.
  • Guide customers as an industry expert on waste and recycling technology, diversion opportunities, city by laws and other regulations to set and meet waste and recycling goals.
  • Work in conjunction with the Sustainability department to assist customers with complex needs around waste auditing, diversion reporting, and other services as required.
  • Attending and presenting at client meetings as well as at other company functions, networking events or as necessary to perform duties and manage customer portfolio.
  • Executing service requests directly with hauling partners, including but not limited to extra pickups, temporary bins, roll-off haul requests.
  • Other duties or projects as requested.

 

Is this you?

Must Have” Skills/Experience:

  • 2+ years experience in Account Management, procurement negotiations, and/or customer success.
  • Previous experience in the waste and recycling industry
  • Bachelor degree or equivalent
  • Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to provide excellent project execution via strong task prioritization and multi-tasking ability with minimal supervision
  • Demonstrates a willingness to not only ensure the job is done, but also accept responsibility for the results
  • Self-driven with the ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks
  • Ability to work in a team environment, while delivering independent results
  • High degree of knowledge of service industry is preferred
  • Experience working in robust Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system such as Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, SAP or Netsuite.

 “Nice to Have” Skills/Experience:

  • Previous experience in business analysis & diversion is an asset
  • Fluency in other languages an asset

Why join RTS:

At RTS, each eligible employee receives a competitive total compensation package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and Short-Term Disability. Our employees also receive Paid Vacation, Holidays, and Sick Days. Please note that benefits may vary by job and offer. Additional Educational opportunities and training may be available at the approval of management.

What to Expect:

We believe the recruiting process is a two-way street, this isn’t just about us getting to know you. We encourage you to ask questions about the company, work culture and the role. As you interview with RTS, we hope the growth and challenge excites you.

  1. You will chat with our talent acquisition team.
  2. Meet with the hiring manager and potential team.
  3. Meet with one of our leaders and learn more about your career at RTS.

RTS is an equal opportunity employer who embraces and values diversity in age, gender identity, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, and physical/mental ability. RTS’ team members are encouraged to be their whole authentic selves. People of diverse backgrounds and cultures are encouraged to apply.

raw.description:
Senior SAP Fiori Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP Fiori Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Fiori Developer to design, build, and enhance modern, user-friendly SAP applications that meet enterprise standards for usability, performance, and maintainability. In this role you will own the full Fiori/UI5 development lifecycle, working closely with functional consultants, ABAP developers, and UX teams to deliver responsive Fiori applications across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. The ideal candidate will combine deep expertise in SAPUI5, Fiori elements, and OData with a strong sense of UX, accessibility, and clean-architecture principles, and will adhere to SAP Fiori Design Guidelines while delivering business value through well-designed user experiences.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop SAP Fiori applications using SAPUI5, Fiori elements, and the Fiori Launchpad, ensuring adherence to SAP Fiori Design Guidelines.
  • Build and consume OData v2/v4 services, including model definitions, navigation properties, expansions, and batch operations.
  • Implement custom controls, formatters, fragments, and reusable components in line with internal coding standards.
  • Develop role-based Fiori Launchpad configurations, including catalogs, groups, tiles, and target mappings.
  • Optimize Fiori applications for performance, including bundling, caching, lazy loading, and reduction of network round trips.
  • Build adaptive applications using flexibility services and key-user adaptation features of S/4HANA.
  • Implement strong authentication and authorization patterns aligned with SAP security guidelines.
  • Integrate Fiori applications with SAP BTP services, including XSUAA, Workflow, and Document Service.
  • Support deployment of Fiori applications to both ABAP frontend servers and BTP-hosted runtimes.
  • Collaborate closely with ABAP developers to define backend OData services and CDS views that support efficient Fiori applications.
  • Conduct thorough functional, regression, and cross-device/cross-browser testing of applications, including edge-case validation and accessibility checks, to ensure consistent user experience across the supported platform matrix.
  • Provide hypercare and post-go-live support, including issue triage, performance tuning, and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Ten or more years of SAP Fiori / UI5 development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAPUI5, Fiori elements, and the Fiori Launchpad.
  • Solid experience with OData v2/v4 modeling and consumption.
  • Hands-on experience with HTML5, JavaScript (ES6+), and CSS.
  • Working knowledge of ABAP CDS views, BOPF, and gateway service development.
  • Experience deploying Fiori applications to ABAP frontend and BTP runtimes.
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, and SAP security patterns.
  • Excellent attention to UX, accessibility, and performance.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
How to Apply

Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

raw.description:
Mogl is hiring a high-performing Account Executive based in Chicago to join our growing Sales team. This remote role offers a unique opportunity to be one of the first sales hires in the Chicago market.

We are looking for a strategic, self-motivated sales professional with deep experience in buy-side programmatic advertising (DSPs) and a strong network of agency and direct client relationships. The ideal candidate thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, has a proven track record of driving revenue growth, and excels at building meaningful client partnerships.

As a key member of our expanding sales team, you will take ownership of growing an established book of business while identifying new opportunities across the region. This is an exciting opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping Mogl's presence in Chicago and contributing directly to the company's continued growth.

WHO WE ARE

Mogl is the only purpose-built Certified Service Partner (reseller) for The Trade Desk. One of the fastest-growing companies in North America, Mogl delivers performance-driven consulting across the world’s leading media and data platforms. We are guided by a values-driven culture and powered by a team of curious, persistent, and selfless professionals who collaborate to achieve ambitious, measurable outcomes. Based in Denver, CO and consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work, Mogl provides meaningful opportunities where team members thrive through challenging and rewarding work programs.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have a minimum of 3–5 years of digital media and/or platform sales experience, preferably at a DSP company such as Basis, Simpli.fi, or StackAdapt—direct experience with The Trade Desk platform is preferred.
  • You have demonstrated the ability to create and implement programmatic strategies for clients and have excellent relationships with independent agencies and direct clients across your respective geography
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills, paired with the ability to negotiate and confidently close deals.
  • You achieve excellence across the entire sales spectrum (e.g., email outreach, networking, cold calling, discovery calls, and presentations).
  • You’re well-versed in using Salesforce, email sequencing tools (Smartlead.ai is a bonus), and LinkedIn Navigator to streamline your efforts and maximize results.
  • You have strong quantitative and negotiation skills.
  • Excited by the dynamic, fast-paced environment of a startup and eager to make a direct impact on our growth and success. If you’re passionate about shaping our path forward, this role offers the opportunity to be a key driver of how we get there.

WHAT YOU WILL DO IN THIS ROLE

  • Become a go-to expert on The Trade Desk platform, sharing valuable insights and guiding clients through best practices during the prospecting process.
  • Build and nurture a portfolio of new client accounts—both agency and brand direct—ensuring exceptional satisfaction and strong partnerships at every touchpoint.
  • Lead engaging discovery meetings and product demos (with support from our Trading team), maintaining clear, impactful communication throughout.
  • Act as a key liaison between business development and internal teams, ensuring smooth collaboration and delivering outstanding client success.
  • Secure new partners via MSA contracts and work closely with Account Management and Trading teams for seamless onboarding and growth.
  • Develop and execute strategies in partnership with the Client Services team to drive meaningful client growth.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline, accurately forecasting revenue using Mogl's internal platforms.
  • Stay active in your region’s digital advertising scene, attending events, visiting clients, and participating in client trainings and Mogl events.

WHY YOU WANT TO WORK AT MOGL:

  • Build Something Meaningful – Be part of a fast-growing company where your work directly shapes our growth, culture, and impact.
  • Founder Access & Real Influence – Work closely with engaged founders and leaders who value ideas, initiative, and thoughtful decision-making.
  • High Ownership, High Trust – You will have the autonomy to own your role, make decisions, and see your work make a quick impact.
  • People-First Culture – We invest in our people through learning & development, recognition, and experiences.

Please note this role is open to candidates currently located in Chicago.

  • The estimated pay range for this role is a base salary of $90,000–$110,000 with a commission package that will be discussed prior to an official offer.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

All roles are eligible for the following benefits:

  • Health Care Insurance
  • Company stipends for specific perks – Health & Wellness, Education, Home Office and support with your commute
  • 401k match after 1 year of employment with Mogl
  • Flexible time off – we encourage at least three weeks a year
  • Paid parental leave
  • Flex time between Christmas and New Year's Day
  • 12 Paid Company Holidays

To learn more about our benefits and perks, click HERE.

At Mogl, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified candidates will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation, and related medical conditions), gender identity, or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, military service or veteran status, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

If you have a disability or particular need that requires accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please let our Director of People know.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

  • 5+ years of professional, hands-on CAD modelling (CATIA, SolidWorks, Siemens NX, Creo or similar). Experience preparing geometry for simulation (ANSYS or similar) is a strong plus.
  • An active professional CAD licence of your own (required).
  • Comfortable with Python and GitHub.
  • English at B2 level or above.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Primary Purpose:

As the Senior Director, Strategic Client Relations, you serve as the senior relationship leader for a portfolio of the organization's largest and most strategically important employer-sponsored clients and consultant partners, with a dedicated focus on the law firm market. Responsible for driving long-term client value, retention, revenue growth, and strategic partnership expansion, this role develops multi-year account strategies, advises senior client stakeholders, and leads complex renewal, growth, and competitive retention efforts. Through consultative leadership, business insight, and data-driven planning, the Senior Director aligns Bright Horizons solutions with client workforce priorities and business objectives to strengthen partnerships and accelerate sustainable growth. In addition, this role serves as the internal strategic leader for the law firm vertical, developing market strategies, thought leadership initiatives, and programs that enhance Bright Horizons' position as a valued partner to law firms nationwide.

This is a remote position available in the United States. Only candidates located in the New York Metro area will be considered.


Bright Horizons is a leading education and care company that helps employees thrive at work and at home by partnering with employers to offer high-quality child care, elder care, and educational support. Our workplace reflects this commitment—with collaborative environments, meaningful benefits, and a culture that supports both career growth and personal well-being. Whether you’re caring for children or powering the systems and partnerships that make it all possible, at Bright Horizons, you’re the difference.

  • Build and maintain relationships with executive sponsors, economic buyers, and senior decision-makers while expanding influence across client organizations. Develop influential broker and consultant partnerships that strengthen advocacy and create growth opportunities.

  • Consistently achieve assigned quota targets through proactive account management, renewal execution, upsell/cross-sell strategies, and client advocacy.
  • Serve as the strategic leader for Bright Horizons' law firm client segment, developing and executing a company-wide strategy that advances client retention, growth, market differentiation, and industry influence.
  • Monitor emerging trends, workforce challenges, and competitive dynamics impacting law firms and translate insights into actionable strategies, recommendations, and growth opportunities.
  • Develop and deliver thought leadership focused on caregiver support, workforce participation, talent retention, and employee well-being within the legal industry.

  • Represent Bright Horizons at industry conferences, association events, and law firm forums to strengthen market presence, build relationships, and identify emerging business opportunities.

  • 8-10 years of strategic account management, consulting, client success, workforce solutions, or related B2B relationship management experience.
  • Bachelors degree
    • In lieu of a degree, an additional 7 years of experience may be considered

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated success managing large, complex client relationships, leading renewal and growth strategies, and influencing executive stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting, consulting with, or managing relationships within the legal professional services sector, or similarly complex client environments preferred.
  • Experience developing industry-specific growth strategies, thought leadership initiatives, executive engagement programs, or market development plans preferred.
  • Proven ability to influence across matrixed organizations and lead strategic initiatives without direct authority. Ability to travel as required to support strategic client relationships.
  • Client Relationship Management: Builds trusted partnerships that drive client satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and long-term strategic value.
  • Portfolio Management & Business Growth: Demonstrates success managing complex client portfolios while achieving retention, expansion, and revenue growth objectives.
  • Planning & Organizational Effectiveness: Effectively manages priorities, resources, and deadlines with strong attention to detail and execution excellence.
  • Adaptability & Prioritization: Thrives in fast-paced environments, balancing competing priorities while maintaining high-quality outcomes.

  • Business & Solution Expertise: Maintains comprehensive knowledge of Bright Horizons services and solutions, leveraging expertise to address client needs and identify growth opportunities.

  • Thought Leadership & Strategic Influence: Establishes credibility as a trusted advisor through industry expertise, executive-level communication, and development of relevant market insights. Relationship Ecosystem Development: Creates opportunities for client collaboration, peer networking, and community engagement that strengthen partnerships and deliver measurable value to clients.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Effectively aligns internal stakeholders around industry strategy, market priorities, and client-focused initiatives to achieve business objectives.

Be part of a community where people grow, futures are shaped, and lives are changed. We offer the rewards, opportunities, and support you deserve because making a difference goes both ways. Job Description

Your Opportunity as the National Account Executive, Convenience Sales Team

You will be responsible for delivering Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s), focused on delivering sales revenue and market share targets for the Convenience and Drug Channel by executing sales, marketing, category management and trade spend plans. This position directs a broker team and has accountability for Large Multi-State Convenience and Drug chains. You will be accountable for delivering growth targets for all defined J.M. Smucker product categories.


Work Location/Arrangements: Working Remotely - Preference to living within the Dallas, TX area and accessible to a major airport. Travel as necessary.


In this role you will:


Business Development

  • Achieve assigned volume and margin business plan objectives for categories supporting SBA plan targets
  • Support the cross-functional development of sales plans, strategies, objectives, policies, and procedures for Smucker business with customer that supports the overall business unit objectives
  • Identify and make recommendations concerning changes in market, industry and/or competitive situations that offer opportunities for profitable growth
  • Manage trade and departmental spend budgets
  • Manage financial business aspects to include P&L statements and margin targets for assigned accounts
  • Broker management within Market Area to include Business Development, Customer Development and Field Sales execution with the Broker Team.
  • Responsible for maintaining existing business (retention), development of new business across current and new customer base (acquisition), and execution against set customer and segment objectives
  • Manage Multiple Categories with Multiple Category Managers, strategies and goals.

Customer Development

  • Create and execute defined annual customer business plans with specific growth objectives tied to strategic categories and SBA objectives
  • Contract development, negotiation, and management for renewals of current business and new business against assigned accounts
  • Plan and execute quarterly business reviews with assigned accounts or as required to drive business and build relationships at various levels with accounts
  • Manage promotional activities to ensure effective execution of sales plans
  • Build broad and strong-layered relationships between the account and the JMS organization so the relationships are institutional rather than individual and assure continuity of the business and the relationships
  • Travel requirements assume 2 nights per week or, 60% of time managing face-to-face customer and broker relationships.
  • Cross functional within Smucker and customer (Sales Operations, Customer Marketing, Channel Commercialization, Category Management, Trade Team and Revenue Growth Management)
  • Deal with all management levels at the assigned customer to optimize customer relationships and sales results
  • Customer headquarters and field management to include (as necessary) purchasing, marketing, R&D, operations, senior executives, and field operations.
  • Achieve established growth and profitability targets for this customer portfolio including P&L input and review

Business Planning and Analyses

  • Work with syndicated/other data sources to both manage and inform strategic and tactical trade plans
  • Effective trade budget management, accurate and timely visibility
  • Analyze business to discover new ways to penetrate existing and acquire new Convenience business
  • Work cross-functionally internally to gain marketing & finance support to achieve goals
  • Own Ad-hoc financial and data analysis, including pre/post event analysis
  • Own annual JBP, Quarterly Business Reviews and other meetings

What we are looking for:


Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Syndicated data experience (Circana/IRI, Nielsen)
  • Experience working with 7-Eleven
  • 5+ years of CPG sales experience managing Convenience Chains and Convenience Warehouse Distributors
  • 3+ years of experience with broker management
  • Strong negotiation skills
  • Ability to apply strategic thinking and problem solving

Additional skills and experience that we think would make someone successful in this role:

  • An overall understanding of the complexity of the Convenience Channel
  • Experience in presenting Top Level Business Reviews
  • Ability to present opportunities based on financial data and profitability

The Right Place for You

We are bold, kind, strive to do the right thing, we play to win, and we believe in a strong community that thrives together. Our culture is rooted in our Basic Beliefs, and we believe in supporting every employee by meeting their physical, emotional, and financial needs.

Stay connected with us on LinkedIn® 

We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, age, national origin, disability status or protected veteran status.

raw.description:
PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH

Location: Remote, Latin America (LATAM)

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Openings: 1

Industry: Real Estate Finance / Private Lending

Compensation: $1,300 to $1,800 USD/month

Experience: 1.5+ years at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender

Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

English Proficiency: Advanced written and spoken English required

Start Date: As soon as possible (early November 2026)

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based private real estate lender that provides short-term, business-purpose loans to real estate investors.

The company finances Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR rental and Ground-Up Construction projects and works with a third-party loan servicer, note buyers and capital partners to manage its loan portfolio.

As its portfolio grows, the company is building out its remote operations team to keep every funded loan accurately tracked and every borrower well supported.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Loan Servicing Specialist to own the post-closing servicing workflow and borrower and partner follow-through.

You will board funded loans with the third-party servicer, manage construction draws, monitor maturities, payments and delinquencies, and answer borrower and partner questions until each one is resolved.

The third-party servicer prepares servicing calculations; this specialist reviews and coordinates them. Speed, accuracy, ownership and exceptional borrower service are central to the role.

What You'll Do

Loan Boarding & Records

  • Board funded loans with the third-party servicer.
  • Validate terms, balances, reserves and maturity dates.
  • Maintain accurate records in the company's loan portal and servicing systems.

Construction Draws

  • Manage construction draw requests end to end: budget and reserve checks, inspections, documentation, review and approvals within delegated limits.
  • Coordinate disbursements and give borrowers proactive updates.

Maturities, Extensions & Payoffs

  • Monitor upcoming maturities and coordinate extensions.
  • Coordinate payoffs and extensions with the servicer, reviewing its calculations, statements and documents for accuracy.
  • Track completion and lien releases.

Portfolio Monitoring

  • Identify inactive or stalled loans with no recent progress, updates or borrower communication.
  • Contact the relevant parties, document status and escalate risks.
  • Monitor missed payments and delinquencies, follow up with borrowers and the servicer, and escalate potential defaults or unresolved issues.

Borrower & Partner Support

  • Answer borrower, note buyer and warehouse lender questions about loans, draws, balances, payments, extensions and payoffs.
  • Own each inquiry until it is resolved.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 1.5 years of hands-on experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender, originating or servicing business-purpose investment property loans (Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and/or Ground-Up Construction).
  • Direct experience servicing short-term hard money or business-purpose loans.
  • Experience with construction draw management, payoffs and extensions.
  • Advanced written and spoken English.
  • High attention to detail.
  • Ability to work in Gmail, GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM, and an online loan portal for documents, files and workflow.
  • Hardworking, dependable, proactive and accountable. You take ownership and follow up without reminders.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced lending business, handling urgent requests and meeting deadlines without compromising accuracy or controls.
  • Availability to work 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Preferred

  • Experience working with a third-party loan servicer.

Please note: conventional consumer mortgage experience alone (FHA, VA, Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac loans) does not meet the experience requirement.

How Success Is Measured

  • Funded loans are boarded quickly and accurately.
  • Draw requests are processed on time and within approved budgets.
  • Maturities, extensions and payoffs are handled before deadlines.
  • Stalled loans, missed payments and potential defaults are flagged early.
  • Borrower and partner questions get fast, accurate answers.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully Remote Opportunity: Work from anywhere in Latin America with a U.S.-based lender.
  • Competitive Compensation: Earn $1,300 to $1,800 USD per month.
  • Meaningful Responsibility: Own the health of a growing loan portfolio.
  • Professional Growth: Build deeper experience in U.S. private real estate lending and servicing.

Important Notes

  • Candidates must reside in Latin America.
  • Direct experience servicing hard money or business-purpose loans is required.
  • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required.
  • Excellent English communication skills are essential.
  • Please submit your CV in English and include the lender(s) you worked for, your dates of employment and the loan types you handled.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

raw.title: Senior Platform Engineer – Linux & Kubernetes auf Bare Metal (m/w/d)
raw.excerpt: Dein PurposeWir betreiben unsere Hosting-Plattform auf eigener Hardware und bauen sie gerade grundlegend neu: Kubernetes auf Bare Metal, alle Ebenen vom Kernel bis zur Plattform in eigener Verantwortung.
raw.description:
Dein Purpose

Wir betreiben unsere Hosting-Plattform auf eigener Hardware und bauen sie gerade grundlegend neu: Kubernetes auf Bare Metal, alle Ebenen vom Kernel bis zur Plattform in eigener Verantwortung. Du gibst deinem Team dabei die technische Richtung. Deine Urteilskraft kommt aus dem Betrieb, also aus echten Störungen und Kundenproblemen. Daraus entscheidest du im Team, bringst Vorhaben spürbar voran und lässt deine Kolleg*innen fachlich mitwachsen. Personalverantwortung hast du nicht, dafür umso mehr fachlichen Einfluss.

Deine Skills:

  • Du gehst fachlich voran, ohne disziplinarisch zu führen. Du machst Komplexität für Kolleg*innen auf jedem Level greifbar und nimmst sie auf dem Weg mit, durch Feedback, Wissenstransfer und ständiges Sparring.

  • Du beherrschst mindestens eine Ebene richtig tief, ob Kernel, Storage, Netzwerk oder Container-Runtime. Die übrigen verstehst du gut genug, um Wechselwirkungen zu erkennen. Du weißt, wie Kubernetes auf eigener Hardware läuft und was passiert, wenn es das nicht tut.

  • Du analysierst Störungen bis zur Ursache, erkennst Muster hinter wiederkehrenden Problemen und definierst sinnvolle Monitoring- und Alerting-Regeln.

  • Software-Engineering: Du baust Plattformkomponenten und Automatisierung selbst, idealerweise in Go, und kannst die Lösungen anderer fachlich bewerten.

Herausforderungen, mit denen wir uns gerade beschäftigen:

  • Multi-Tenant-Hosting unter echter Last: Tausende Kunden-Workloads teilen sich unsere physischen Server – präzise Ressourcensteuerung (cgroups, Namespaces), CPU-/Memory-Scheduling sowie Storage- und Netzwerk-Performance auf Systemebene gehören zum Alltag.

  • Automatisierter Node- und Cluster-Lifecycle: Vom Provisionieren der Hardware über Kernel- und Runtime-Updates (CRI-O, crun) bis zu unterbrechungsfreien Rollouts im laufenden Betrieb.

  • Eigene Operatoren und Plattform-Services: Statt gemanagte Cloud-Dienste zusammenzustecken, entwickeln wir unsere Kubernetes-Controller, APIs und die Integration in Storage und Netzwerk (CNI, BGP) selbst.

Das bieten wir dir:

Tiefgang statt Standard

Wir arbeiten mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien und bauen Systeme, wenn nötig, lieber selbst, statt auf Fertiglösungen zu setzen. Das bringt Herausforderungen und ein technisches Niveau, das nicht alltäglich ist und dich fachlich weiterbringt.

Expertise, die ihresgleichen sucht

Du diskutierst auf fachlich höchstem Niveau, teilst dein Wissen und lernst gemeinsam mit anderen Experten. Unsere Expertise geben wir nicht nur intern , sondern auch gerne auf Konferenzen, Camps und in der Tech-Community weiter und gestalten so die Zukunft der Branche mit.

Wir lieben Tech

Bei uns triffst du auf Menschen, die Tech genauso feiern wie du. Diese Leidenschaft leben wir im Alltag – und darüber hinaus. Ob Open-Source-Engagement, Community-Arbeit oder der Support von Tech-Events: Wir sind aktiv dabei und bringen uns ein.

Technologische Verantwortung

Deine Expertise zählt. Du prägst Entscheidungen und bleibst nicht beim Offensichtlichen stehen. Du bekommst den Raum, deine Ideen umzusetzen, Systeme mitzugestalten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen – auf Augenhöhe und mit Rückhalt.

Technik trifft Menschlichkeit

Bei uns findest du die coolsten Kolleg*innen, jede Menge Humor und echten Team-Spirit. Zusammenarbeit ist für uns ein fester Teil des Daily Business. Auch nach Feierabend gibt es jede Menge Möglichkeiten, ob Fußball, Padel oder D&D - wer Lust hat, ist dabei.

Rundum-sorglos-Setup

Bei uns soll´s dir richtig gut gehen. Freie Hardwarewahl? Check. Standardpaket an Benefits? Klar. Vitamine, Koffein & H2O? Safe. Und obendrauf: Unbefristeter Vertrag, Gleitzeit, 30 Urlaubstage, bAV , Schulungsangebote und ein faires Gehalt.

Requirements

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du führst die Vorhaben deines Teams fachlich und technisch an, konzipierst neue Funktionen und Stabilitätsverbesserungen

  • Architekturentscheidungen triffst du gemeinsam mit unserer Systemarchitektur und ihr bindet euch bei allen Ideen, Projekten und Veränderungsprozessen gegenseitig frühzeitig ein

  • Mit dem PO übersetzt du Prioritäten in konkrete Arbeitspakete, dabei bewertest du Aufwand und Risiko und sprichst Empfehlungen aus

  • Du bleibst nah am Tagesgeschäft, bist erste Anlaufstelle für technische Fragen an dein Team und spielst Erkenntnisse aus dem Betrieb in die Architektur zurück

  • Du hältst den Qualitätsstandard hoch, steuerst nach, wenn etwas nicht passt

ROLE OVERVIEW


The Senior MDM Data Steward serves as the authoritative steward for patient and provider domains for master data across the Enterprise Data Platform, providing leadership for the operational governance, quality, and integrity of enterprise identity data. This role owns the stewardship framework supporting patient and provider master records and is accountable for ensuring that Enterprise Master Patient Index (EMPI) patient global identifiers and MDM provider global identifiers within the Silver (conformed canonical) layer remain accurate, complete, traceable, and trusted for analytics, reporting, regulatory compliance, operational decision-making, and AI-driven use cases.

Operating with a high degree of independence, the Senior MDM Data Steward leads identity resolution activities, establishes and maintains stewardship standards, and exercises judgment in the review and disposition of complex match, merge, and identity exception scenarios. The steward proactively identifies data quality risks, drives remediation efforts across source systems, oversees survivorship rule execution, and serves as the primary escalation point for patient and provider identity-related issues. In partnership with Business Data Owners, Data Governance leaders, and source-system stakeholders, this role influences stewardship practices, promotes data quality accountability, and drives continuous improvement of master data management processes.


The Senior MDM Data Steward also owns the maintenance and ongoing governance of patient and provider business glossary terms, data quality rules and definitions, lineage context, stewardship procedures, issue records, and related governance artifacts within Snowflake Horizon Catalog. Through active monitoring, analysis, and stewardship leadership, the role ensures critical business and technical metadata remains current, actionable, and aligned with enterprise data governance standards and strategic data management objectives.


Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.

COMPENSATION: $109,000 - $130,000/annually in addition to a competitive bonus plan

KEY RESPONSIBILITES 

Identity Resolution, Match Stewardship, and Operational Leadership (approximately 40%)


  • Lead enterprise MDM stewardship operations by directing work queue activities, adjudicating complex identity resolution scenarios, resolving potential matches and duplicates, correcting improperly merged identities, and establishing consistent record governance practices for manually reviewed records.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for patient identity management issues, investigating overlays, duplicates, and cross-system identity conflicts originating from athenaOne, AdvancedMD, and other source systems; determine root causes, drive corrective actions, and recommend process improvements to reduce recurrence.
  • Own the governance and integrity of the provider master data domain, establishing and enforcing standards for the reconciliation of NPI, taxonomy, licensure, credentialing status, payer enrollment, practice location, employment status, and related attributes across enterprise source systems.
  • Provide leadership for provider data quality and governance initiatives, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and usability of provider practice, location, and organizational affiliation data supporting operational, analytical, credentialing, reimbursement, and regulatory reporting needs.
  • Partner with Data Architecture to evaluate and tune Verato match thresholds, referential matching configuration, survivorship, and attribute precedence rules; measure the effect on auto-match, potential-match, unmatched, and false-positive rates before changes are promoted.
  • Ownership over establishing and maintaining enterprise standards for data stewardship decisions, ensuring comprehensive documentation of exceptions, adjudication rationale, survivorship outcomes, merge and unmerge activities, and record-resolution actions to support auditability, compliance, and continuous improvement efforts.

Data Quality, Issue Management & Silver Layer Validation (approximately 25%)

  • Establish and own the business acceptance standards for patient and provider mastered records, source-to-global ID crosswalks, identity resolution outcomes, and golden-record quality within the Snowflake Silver layer, ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance and operational objectives.
  • Provide oversight of EMPI patient and provider global ID integrity within the Snowflake Silver layer by proactively identifying data quality defects, validating adherence to business rules, and directing remediation efforts with Data Engineering and DataOps teams to ensure timely resolution.
  • Define, govern, and continuously refine master data quality standards and performance thresholds, including metrics related to unmatched records, duplicate records, orphaned source IDs, stale provider attributes, missing NPI values, invalid affiliations, and incomplete required attributes; communicate performance trends and improvement recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Lead the governance and lifecycle management of patient and provider master data issues, prioritizing remediation activities based on business impact, overseeing issue resolution progress, and providing transparent reporting on ownership, remediation status, risk exposure, and closure outcomes.
  • Independently lead strategic trend analysis and root-cause investigations to identify systemic defects across registration, scheduling, provider onboarding, credentialing, human resources, interfaces, and source application workflows; recommend and influence corrective actions that improve data quality and operational efficiency.
  • Own the maintenance and governance of master data lineage and identifier crosswalks, ensuring accurate traceability between source-system MRNs, provider identifiers, and enterprise global IDs while supporting audit, compliance, and operational reporting requirements.
  • Serve as the primary business lead for identity-related incidents and data quality escalations, coordinating cross-functional resolution efforts, driving stakeholder alignment, and ensuring corrective actions are effectively prioritized, tested, and promoted through established release and change-management processes.

Governance, Metadata & Policy (approximately 20%)

  • Establish and govern enterprise patient and provider master data standards, defining business terminology, required attributes, permissible values, data ownership, attribute precedence, relationship hierarchies, and merge/unmerge policies to ensure consistent and compliant master data management practices across the organization.
  • Own the stewardship framework and metadata management processes for Patient and Provider domains by maintaining business glossary terms, data quality standards, stewardship procedures, issue records, and lineage documentation within the Snowflake Horizon Catalog, ensuring transparency and accessibility for business and technical stakeholders.
  • Serve independently as the primary stewardship leader for Patient and Provider domains within the Data Governance Steering Committee, influencing enterprise governance decisions and partnering with Business Data Owners to establish data definitions, quality expectations, usage standards, and remediation priorities.
  • Provide governance leadership and strategic recommendations to Business Data Owners, enabling informed decision-making regarding business definitions, quality thresholds, and stewardship policy changes while ensuring alignment with enterprise data management objectives.
  • Lead the evaluation and governance of changes impacting master data policies, including data definitions, identity matching criteria, survivorship logic, and quality thresholds; facilitate cross-functional review, stakeholder alignment, risk assessment, and decision-making through established governance processes.
  • Independently ensure stewardship operations adhere to HIPAA minimum-necessary requirements, HITRUST controls, and organizational privacy and security policies, establishing robust auditability and oversight for manual merge, split, correction, and identity-resolution activities.
  • Partner with Privacy, Compliance, and business stakeholders to assess regulatory and policy impacts on identity management practices, providing stewardship leadership for consent restrictions, sensitive data handling requirements, healthcare regulatory obligations, golden-record usage, and downstream data access controls.
  • Drive the development and continuous improvement of master data standards that support regulatory reporting, quality initiatives, reimbursement processes, payer requirements, and broader enterprise business objectives, ensuring data assets remain reliable, compliant, and fit for purpose across the organization.

Source-System Improvement, Reporting & Enablement (approximately 15%)

  • Provide leadership and oversight for enterprise master data remediation efforts, directing corrective actions to registration, provider credentialing, human resources, practice operations, and other source-system owners; ensure timely resolution, accountability, and sustainable process improvements that prevent recurring data quality issues within mastered records.
  • Partner with operational and business leaders to strengthen upstream data governance and capture processes, identifying opportunities to enhance controls, workflows, and accountability measures that reduce the creation of duplicate, incomplete, and conflicting patient and provider records at the source.
  • Develop, own, and present executive-level stewardship performance reporting, delivering monthly scorecards and actionable insights on duplicate rates, unmatched records, match accuracy, exception backlog and aging, source correction effectiveness, provider data completeness, global ID coverage, and recurring root-cause trends to support informed decision-making.
  • Serve as the primary stewardship liaison with MDM vendors and implementation partners, providing leadership in troubleshooting match-quality issues, evaluating configuration recommendations, validating platform capabilities, assessing business impacts, and guiding release planning and implementation decisions.
  • Lead business stewardship activities for MDM platform implementations and enhancements, overseeing data profiling, duplicate remediation strategies, threshold calibration, user acceptance testing, cutover readiness, workflow adoption, stakeholder engagement, and post-production stabilization to ensure successful implementation outcomes and sustained business value.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in healthcare data stewardship, health information management (HIM), patient identity, provider data management, or MDM operations, including direct responsibility for patient or provider master data quality.
  • Hands-on experience with an enterprise EMPI or MDM platform, including steward queue management, duplicate remediation, merge/unmerge workflows, survivorship, and match-rule evaluation. Verato experience is strongly preferred; Reltio, NextGate/Rhapsody, Profisee, IBM Initiate, or comparable experience is acceptable.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare patients and provider data structures and workflows. Experience with athenaOne is strongly preferred; familiarity with Salesforce provider credentialing and Workday as provider data sources is a plus.
  • Provider data expertise, including NPI/NPPES, taxonomy, state licensure, credentialing lifecycle, payer enrollment, locations, affiliations, and organizational relationships.
  • Proficient SQL skills and the ability to independently query Snowflake to investigate identity issues, validate global ID assignments, profile defects, and verify remediation.
  • Experience defining data quality rules, managing issue backlogs, performing root-cause analysis, and communicating trends and business impact to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Understanding of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as applied to identity data, access, auditability, and merge/unmerge operations.
  • Ability to document standards, facilitate cross-functional decisions, train operational users, and communicate data quality findings to non-technical leaders.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives, providing strategic direction, driving stakeholder alignment, and coordinating business and technical teams to achieve measurable data quality, governance, and operational outcomes.
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States
  • LifeStance is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
  • Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE


  • Experience with Snowflake Horizon Catalog or another enterprise data catalog/governance platform, including business glossary, ownership, quality, and lineage documentation.
  • Experience reading data models, interpreting automated test results, and working within medallion or layered data architectures.
  • Experience in behavioral health, multi-site outpatient practice, or another complex healthcare delivery environment.
  • Familiarity with referential, probabilistic, and deterministic matching methods and their operational tradeoffs.
  • Experience supporting an EMPI or MDM implementation, including source profiling, initial-load remediation, threshold calibration, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
  • Experience producing stewardship scorecards and presenting data quality trends to governance or operational leadership.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS


  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.
