raw.description:
NRTC is a dynamic and growing cooperative with more than 800 employees operating out of eight office locations. We are member-driven and technology-focused, providing solutions that help our 1,500 electric and telephone members bring all the advantages of today's evolving technology to rural America. Our solutions are developed specifically to meet the needs of rural utilities and their customers and include integrated broadband, managed services, smart grid, mobile, and video solutions.

Pivot, an NRTC company, is a marketing and customer experience agency with a focus on collaborating with people who are doing meaningful work in the communities they serve. Pivot comes alongside these organizations to help them grow and thrive by assisting them in defining and living out their brands, telling their unique stories, and strengthening relationships with their customers. Pivot has four practice areas, including broadband marketing, broadband CX, broadband vendors, and nonprofits.

Job Summary

The Digital Marketing Specialist is responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns across paid search, social media, and emerging digital channels. This role combines strategic thinking, creative content development, and data analysis to help Pivot and its clients grow brand awareness, strengthen customer engagement, and achieve measurable business results while delivering an exceptional client experience.

Responsibilities

  • Research, develop, execute, optimize, and analyze paid social and search engine marketing campaigns across multiple ad accounts and platforms, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, Nextdoor Ads, MNTN Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and other digital advertising platforms.

  • Set up, monitor, and analyze conversion tracking for paid advertising campaigns using tools such as Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics.

  • Identify, develop, and evaluate social media and search engine marketing strategies based on knowledge of established objectives, market characteristics, and cost factors for B2B and B2C audiences

  • Build and maintain Pivot’s and our client’s social media presence through strategy, content creation, and publication of organic social efforts

  • Conduct social media and/or search engine marketing audits and provide strategic recommendations on clients’ social strategy and presence

  • Maintain an understanding of the emerging digital trends as they relate to social media and/or search engine marketing effectiveness

  • Develop expertise in generative search optimization (GSO) and AI-powered marketing tools, including understanding how AI platforms like ChatGPT and similar technologies impact search behavior and content strategy

  • Develop educational resources for the Pivot team

  • Participate in creative brainstorming sessions and contribute to strategy development for digital marketing campaigns and client initiatives.

  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities  

  • Excellent understanding of social media platforms, including their respective strengths and demographics (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Pinterest, Snapchat, TikTok, Nextdoor, YouTube).

  • Ability to navigate both the creative and analytical sides of social media content development and publication

  • Knowledge and a foundational understanding of SEO audits, optimization, and reporting are preferred

  • Experience working with multiple clients simultaneously

  • Strong understanding of customer and market dynamics and requirements

  • Proven ability to build strong relationships with clients

  • Excellence in grammar and professional writing skills is a must

  • Must be able to work accurately with great attention to detail

  • Must be a good communicator, working with other departments that provide services

  • Experience with non-profits is a plus

  • Ability to communicate a clear message

  • Ability to encourage and persuade clients to try something new
  • Google Ad Certification preferred

  • Ability to “sell” your ideas

Minimum Education and Experience   

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Public Relations, Business, Digital Media, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience

  • Minimum 2 years of professional paid social media and/or Google Ads experience required

Physical Demands

  • Work is typically performed in a remote office setting

  • Occasional travel may be required up to 5%

  • Must be able to provide reliable internet connection and a quiet, distraction free environment

raw.description:
Although this role is remote, the ideal candidate will be located on the East Coast, US, and will work within the Eastern time zone

Absolute Security is looking for a Sales Engineer (SE) to provide technical sales support as a solution expert within our fast-growing North American Mid-Market East business, supporting our East Coast customers and partners. The SE is a highly technical sales professional who is responsible for working with their account teams to drive significant revenue growth within the region.

The SE owns the end-to-end technical sales process, from initial discovery through validation to commercial win. The SE is a technical evangelist for our software platform, representing the company with potential customers, partners, and at events.

You lead deep discovery that uncovers each customer’s current state, the cost of staying there, and the outcomes they want, then position technical solutions that deliver real business value. You can tailor demonstrations to align with the pain discovered. You can build Proof of Value (PoV) plans that validate the solution is strongly aligned with the customer needs and delivers quantifiable business value. You can lead the PoV with the customer, then partner with your account teams to turn the results into business proposals and wrap-up presentations that clearly demonstrate the value delivered. You can smoothly handle objections while remaining focused on the important differentiators. Finally, you can effectively build technical champions inside accounts and operate independently of them, but in partnership with your AE and CAM.

You will be expected to quickly come up to speed on our Absolute Secure Endpoint (Visibility, Control, Resilience, Resilience for Security and Resilience for Automation tiers) and Secure Access product offerings (Absolute VPN, Absolute ZTNA and Absolute Insights for Network). Your deep product knowledge, as well as in-depth knowledge of security, networking, and operating systems will help you to effectively position our products, while also helping to solve difficult technical problems for potential customers during pre-sales presentations, demonstrations, and evaluations.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end technical sales cycle for your opportunities, from discovery and validation through to commercial win
  • Partner with your account team to establish and execute sales strategy across your assigned East Coast territory
  • Assist with ongoing qualification and discovery to ensure proposed solutions address customer pain
  • Deliver tailored technical sales presentations and demonstrations to prospective customers and partners
  • Plan and execute Proof of Value (PoV, evaluation) activities. This includes scoping the PoV to align with the business pain, defining relevant success criteria and metrics, designing the PoV environment, installing and configuring Absolute’s products, providing technical support to prospective customers, and executing the PoV in accordance with the agreed-upon success criteria
  • Work with leadership to relay data-driven customer insights to Product Management and help prioritize roadmap features
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all sales activities in Salesforce.com
  • Align tightly with technical counterparts across our channel and OEM business, educating and enabling them to uncover and develop new sales opportunities
  • Provide technical expertise to support renewals, expansion, upsell, cross-sell, and net new business
  • Regularly travel within the assigned East Coast territory to support sales activities, strengthen partner relationships, and engage with customers; up to 30% travel may be required
  • Manage your territory with minimal oversight, independently learning, troubleshooting, and escalating issues when necessary
  • Assist with customer vendor assessments by providing accurate technical and security information and timely, thorough responses to due diligence requests
  • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers

What You’ll Bring:

  • Hands-on experience administering Windows, Linux, and macOS environments, both endpoints and servers, with a clear understanding of the unique management, performance, and security challenges each platform presents
  • Experience with complex technical sales cycles, including deep discovery as well as scoping, executing, and presenting complex Proof of Value (evaluations)
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to all levels of people, from IT, Network and Security managers to Line of Business owners to CIO and CISOs
  • Strong understanding of data-in-transit security (TLS, IPsec, VPNs, PKI, and certificate management), network services and design (routing, LAN/WAN architecture, and firewall configuration), and authentication protocols (SAML, RADIUS, and related methods)
  • Skilled in endpoint and network troubleshooting, leveraging tools such as cURL, Wireshark, and log analysis to identify, isolate, and resolve complex technical issues across diverse environments

Nice to have skills:

  • Experience with selling methodologies such as Command of the Message and MEDDPICC
  • Experience with Demo2Win methodology
  • Experience selling SASE, SSE, VPN, EDR, Incident Response or other endpoint or network security tools
  • Experience with programming or scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash
  • Experience with Cloud IaaS vendors including networking and security service operation
  • Security (CISSP, GIAC, CompTIA Security+, etc.) or networking (CCNA, CompTIA Network+, etc.) certifications
  • Experienced in patch and configuration management for endpoints and servers to maintain security, stability, and compliance
  • Experience in IT or Security operations

Join the “Get Stuff Done” Culture Shaping the Future of Cybersecurity and Resilience

Are you passionate and committed to cybersecurity and cyber resilience in the new era of Frontier AI? If the answer is yes, then Absolute Security may be the home for you.

In the new AI-driven business world, Absolute Security has emerged as a leader in Autonomous Cyber Resilience. Thousands of customers trust our AI-native platform to defend their organizations against threats, reduce risk, and recover immediately from disruptions before they turn into financial losses. Through partnerships with the world’s leading endpoint device manufacturers, Absolute is embedded in the firmware of 600 million endpoints. This unique position gives us an almost ubiquitous presence in the world’s PC and advanced AI workstation environments.

As part of our mission to become the World’s Most Trusted Security Company, we are shaping the next decade of security, compliance, and resilience through innovations that help customers remain defended against AI-driven threats and challenges, stop downtime when disruption hits, and drive meaningful change in the IT and cybersecurity markets. To further our goals, we are searching for the best and brightest to join our Get Stuff Done (GSD) culture. We seek motivated candidates who are innovators, sellers, marketers, financiers, operators, engineers, developers, and customer professionals to join our world-class team.

Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Frost & Sullivan, and other top industry analyst firms recognize Absolute Security as critical to the emerging Cyber Resilience market, and a key competitor in the endpoint management and security, secure network access, and Zero Trust markets. The company has earned prestigious product and leadership honors including the Frost & Sullivan Competitive Strategy & Leadership award, the Cybersecurity Excellence Award for Cyber Resilience solutions, and the SC Magazine Power Players list.

Absolute Security is headquartered in Seattle, Washington, with international offices in Vancouver, BC; Austin, TX; Ankeny, IA; Reading, UK; Tokyo, Japan; and Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. As a native work-from-anywhere company, we give employees the flexibility to thrive in remote, hybrid, and in-office environments.

MarshBerry, a subsidiary of Lincoln International, is growing! We are seeking a Regional Relationship Directorto join our team. We have a people-first, fast-paced, collaborative culture with plenty of opportunity for growth. MarshBerry has been successful in achieving growth objectives because of the trust our clients place in our talented team of professionals, and all MarshBerry colleagues play a critical role in directly or indirectly cultivating those trusted relationships. MarshBerry provides an environment where employees can learn, improve, and realize their career goals. We offer competitive benefits, hybrid work schedules, new challenges, and learning experiences.

Position Summary:

FirstChoice is currently seeking a Regional Relationship Director to join our growing team. TheRegional Relationship Director is responsible for member engagement. They drive the growth and profitability of an assigned territory by developing and executing strategic sales initiatives that strengthen relationships with members, carrier partners, and strategic partners. This role is accountable for member retention, expanding membership, influencing organic growth, strategic planning, new member initiation & recruitment, onboarding new members, and driving profitable growth by identifying and developing aggregation opportunities within the territory.

This is a remote-based position. The ideal candidate will be located in either Maryland (Baltimore area preferably), Delaware, or southeastern Pennsylvania.

Serving as the primary relationship manager, the Regional Relationship Director leads member retention, cultivates strategic partnerships, and expands market presence through a consultative, team-selling approach.

Success in this role requires a proactive, relationship-driven leader who can identify growth opportunities, build trusted partnerships, and collaborate effectively with the Regional Vice President Regional Vice President and the Business Development Director and our internal teams to deliver sustainable growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Proactively develops, cultivates, and maintains strong relationships with existing members to maximize retention and profitable growth.
  • Serves as a trusted advisor and advocates for members by connecting them with relevant resources and solutions.
  • Increases membership, revenue, and aggregated premium volume within the assigned territory.
  • Owns and develops carrier relationships in the region.
  • Collaborates with carrier representatives to build new relationships and strengthen partnerships while identifying joint growth opportunities, enhance member value, and consistently ask for introductions to generate qualified prospective member referrals.
  • Plans and hosts regional member meetings annually.
  • Builds and maintains a consistent opportunity pipeline of prospective members through prospecting, networking, referrals, and market intelligence.
  • Collaborates with the Business Development Director and Regional Vice President to initiate new prospective members.
  • Utilizes Salesforce to plan, log calls, meetings, and execute sales strategies.

Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers, don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As a Senior Copywriter, you will join a fast-growing digital operations team within a dynamic beauty and hair-care brand expanding its reach across LATAM. Operating as part of a high-output creative unit, you will be responsible for producing consistent, performance-oriented content across paid advertising, organic social, lifecycle marketing, and e-commerce touchpoints.

In this high-impact role, you will take ownership of maintaining a clear, honest, reassuring, and knowledgeable brand voice. You will balance creative narrative execution with compliance rigor, ensuring all customer-facing communications accurately align with established beauty and hair-care product claim guidelines while driving conversion across digital channels.

Accountability

As a Senior Copywriter, your success will be defined by your ability to maintain brand voice consistency, drive engagement and advertising effectiveness, and deliver compliant, high-converting copy across channels.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Brand Voice & Editorial Compliance

  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all customer-facing communications, ensuring messaging remains honest, reassuring, and knowledgeable.
  • Translate creative briefs into compelling, audience-appropriate copy while maintaining standardized terminology and brand messaging.
  • Review and refine all written assets for clarity, grammar, tone, and editorial accuracy.
  • Ensure copy complies strictly with applicable product-claim requirements, identifying and escalating potentially problematic claims for review.

Paid Advertising & Performance Copywriting

  • Write high-converting digital advertising copy, attention-grabbing headlines, and creative messaging concepts.
  • Produce weekly advertising copy variations and short-form video scripts to support ongoing campaign iteration.
  • Incorporate performance learnings, including ad CTR, hook rates, email click rates, and conversion insights, to refine messaging and develop new copy variations.

Short-Form Video Scripts & Creator Briefs

  • Develop scripts and opening hooks for short-form video, creator, and user-generated content (UGC).
  • Draft comprehensive brief copy and messaging concepts to guide creators and video editors in high-volume production environments.
  • Translate approved concepts into multiple executable hook and script variations.

Lifecycle Email & SMS Copywriting

  • Develop engaging email and SMS copy for retention programs, promotional events, and customer lifecycle campaigns.
  • Write compelling subject lines, preview text, call-to-action buttons, and targeted SMS messaging.
  • Adapt messaging for distinct customer segments to support lifecycle engagement and improve click rates.

Product Detail Pages & Marketplace Listings

  • Write, refresh, and optimize product detail page (PDP) copy across direct-to-consumer and marketplace sales channels.
  • Craft persuasive, compliant copy for Amazon and TikTok Shop listings to communicate product benefits clearly.
  • Improve listing structure, readability, and customer understanding to support conversion rate goals.

Colleagues

You will work directly with the Creative Director as your primary reporting manager while collaborating closely with the Director of Retention, Chief Marketing Officer, and the broader creative team, including video editors and graphic designers. At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area,paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Senior Copywriter, your vertical strength will be DTC beauty and performance copywriting, while your horizontal capabilities should span channel-specific conversion optimization,regulatory claims awareness, and collaborative creative execution.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: Native-level or C2-equivalent English proficiency with proven professional copywriting experience in DTC, e-commerce, beauty, or hair-care brands.
  • Tools/Systems: Experience utilizing AI-assisted tools for copy ideation, research, and variation generation paired with strong independent editing judgment; familiarity with marketplace platforms like Amazon and TikTok Shop.
  • Analytics/Process: Strong background in writing compliant product claims, evaluating performance metrics (ad CTR, hook rate, email click rate, PDP conversion), and executing rapid copy turnarounds under tight timelines.
  • Mindset: Highly responsive to feedback, detail-oriented editorial judgment, and a balanced ability to write both persuasive conversion-focused copy and reassuring, educational product content.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Brand Voice & Messaging Discipline: How do you maintain a consistent, reassuring, and honest brand tone while meeting performance objectives?
  • Claims Compliance & Accuracy: How do you evaluate beauty or hair-care product messaging to ensure compliance with product claim requirements?
  • Paid Advertising & Video Hooks: How do you structure short-form video scripts and high-converting hooks to capture audience attention?
  • Multi-Channel Adaptation: How do you adapt messaging across paid social, lifecycle email/SMS, PDPs, Amazon,and TikTok Shop listings?

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

Why ThedaCare?

Living A Life Inspired!

Our new vision at ThedaCare is bold, ambitious, and ignited by a shared passion to provide outstanding care. We are inspired to reinvent health care by becoming a proactive partner in health, enriching the lives of all and creating value in everything we do. Each of us are called to take action in delivering higher standards of care, lower costs and a healthier future for our patients, our families, our communities and our world.

At ThedaCare, our team members are empowered to be the catalyst of change through our values of compassion, excellence, leadership, innovation, and agility. A career means much more than excellent compensation and benefits. Our team members are supported by continued opportunities for learning and development, accessible and transparent leadership, and a commitment to work/life balance. If you’re interested in joining a health care system that is changing the face of care and well-being in our community, we encourage you to explore a future with ThedaCare.

Benefits, with a whole-person approach to wellness –

  • Lifestyle Engagement
    • e.g. health coaches, relaxation rooms, health focused apps (Wonder, Ripple), mental health support
  • Access & Affordability
    • e.g. minimal or zero copays, team member cost sharing premiums, daycare

About ThedaCare!

Summary :

The Social Worker MSW provides quality psychosocial care to patients and coordinates care with the medical team while consistently applying the social work code of ethics. Through the coordination of care, conducts a thorough assessment of the patient’s needs. Understands the medical plan of care, coping abilities, and barriers to care. Implements interventions and/or provides resources.

Job Description:

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Identifies patients with complex care needs, conducts patient psychosocial status assessment, establishes a rapport with patient/family, and actively participates in creating and implementing a plan of care to achieve outcomes.

  • Utilizes effective oral and written communication skills to collaborate with the health care team as needed to enhance quality and care.

  • Develops psychosocial plan of intervention for the patient and family utilizing resources within the community. Incorporates social, emotional, financial, and spiritual aspects of care into the patient’s plan.

  • Evaluates progress toward outcomes/goals for individual plan for patient and modifies plan as appropriate.

  • Serves as a consultant, patient advocate, and liaison for patients and families in areas of social work needs and complex psychosocial issues that could include facilitation of specialty-specific psychoeducational support groups in some care settings.

  • Arranges for resources/funds to obtain medications, DME, housing, transportation, and other needed services. Facilitates appropriate and prompt access to primary care providers, physician specialists, and similar services as necessary.

  • Coordinates patient information and communication between and among the patient/family and the referring/accepting facilities, and communicates to caregivers as applicable to ensure smooth transition of care.

  • Advocates for the patient and performs discharge planning/after care coordination. Supports efforts to decrease hospital readmissions when possible and returns patient to the community with appropriate resources.

  • Facilitates advanced care planning and lifespan planning.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Master’s degree in social work

  • Licensed/Certified as Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), Advanced Practice Social Worker (APSW), Certified Independent Social Worker (CISW), or Certified Social Worker (CSW)

  • American Heart Association Healthcare Provider Basic Life Support (BLS)

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Ability to move freely (standing, stooping, walking, bending, pushing, and pulling) and lift up to a maximum of twenty-five (25) pounds without assistance

  • Job classification is exposed to blood borne pathogens (blood or bodily fluids) while performing job duties

Machine Learning Engineer IV – (Computer Vision)

We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. You’ll build and train models, and own ML systems end-to-end on AWS. The final job level for this role will be determined following the interview process.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)
  • Rigorous fairness analysis and benchmarking of biometric models across various datasets and operating conditions.
  • Architect, train, and optimize models using PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or JAX
  • Own and evolve end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to deployment. Design automated pipelines (Airflow) for data ingestion and cleaning. You will be responsible for curating balanced training sets and generating synthetic data to address both quality and diversity gaps.
  • Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.
  • Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong industry experience in Machine Learning, dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.
  • Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.
  • Fairness & Ethics: You understand the sources of algorithmic bias in Computer Vision and have practical experience measuring and mitigating disparate impact.
  • Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.
  • Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.
  • Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).

Nice to Have

  • Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.
  • Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.
  • Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.
  • Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.
  • Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.
  • Strong communication skills.

Equal Opportunities:

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.

Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

raw.description:
About the Role:

One owner for the entire risk function at a fintech operating between crypto and traditional payments. You will own enterprise risk end to end, including the risk framework and appetite, DORA and operational resilience, B2B partner risk, fraud risk appetite, capital adequacy, and risk gating for new products.

It is an individual contributor role reporting directly to the CEO, with a seat on the leadership team. You will work daily with Compliance, Legal, Finance, Technology, and the B2B Partnerships team. The foundations are in place (risk register, appetite framework, DORA workstreams). The function needs an owner who proactively surfaces risk, takes a position, and stands behind it.

What You'll Do:

Enterprise Risk & Governance:

  • Own the enterprise risk framework: risk register, risk appetite statement, taxonomy, and escalation policy.
  • Run the risk reporting cycle: structured updates to the CEO and leadership, plus regulatory risk reporting.
  • Chair or co-chair the risk committee: agenda, cadence, participants, and decision authority.
  • Build risk ownership across business units.

DORA & Operational Resilience:

  • Own the DORA ICT risk framework and lead the Register of Information workstream ahead of the 2027 submission window.
  • Own business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
  • Own third-party and vendor risk: critical providers, concentration risk, and exit planning.
  • Own the PSD2 operational resilience framework, including 4-hour major incident reporting and impact tolerances.
  • Partner with the CTO and Head of Security on technology and cloud risk.

EMI & Regulatory Risk:

  • Lead the operational risk framework and capital adequacy/safeguarding design for two parallel EMI applications (EU and UK).
  • Own ongoing capital adequacy monitoring and escalate breaches.
  • Own preparation for risk-focused regulatory examinations and act as the primary contact for risk-related regulator queries.
  • Coordinate with Legal on regulatory obligations and with the Chief of Compliance on AML/CTF risk appetite.

B2B Partner & Counterparty Risk:

  • Design and own the partner risk assessment framework: onboarding scoring, ongoing due diligence, and risk-tiered monitoring.
  • Own risk sign-off on material partnerships, define thresholds for CEO approval, and keep high-risk reviews fast and credible.
  • Define which industries, geographies, and business models the company will and will not serve.
  • Manage partner concentration risk and delegated-compliance liability as B2B volume scales.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk:

  • Build a unified fraud risk framework and appetite across relevant functions, with clear ownership and a single escalation path.
  • Set fraud risk appetite by channel, product, and geography, and own decisions when thresholds are breached.
  • Coordinate with the Chief of Compliance on the fraud/AML overlap.
  • Own the sanctions screening risk framework and escalation policy.

Product & Financial Risk:

  • Own product-launch risk gating for new products, markets, and business lines.
  • Manage crypto price volatility exposure: conversion timing, settlement risk, and liquidity buffers.
  • Own counterparty credit risk: liquidity providers, banking partners, card schemes, and B2B clients.
  • Oversee treasury risk: balances, currency exposure, and concentration.

Requirements:

Must have:

  • Senior risk leadership (Head of Risk, VP Risk, or equivalent scope) in financial services or fintech within a regulated institution.
  • Direct ownership of risk obligations in a licensed fintech, EMI, PSP, payment institution, or crypto company, not advisory or consultancy experience only.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: DORA ICT risk framework, MiCA capital adequacy and risk requirements, PSD2 operational resilience, or FCA operational resilience.
  • Fraud risk ownership: has set fraud risk appetite, owned fraud outcomes, and made real decisioning calls.
  • B2B partner or counterparty risk: has assessed and approved high-risk commercial relationships.
  • Ability to make a risk decision and stand behind it under CEO or commercial pressure.
  • High autonomy: surfaces risk proactively, proposes a route, and closes actions without waiting for direction.
  • Ability to give commercial teams a fast, credible risk answer that enables deal velocity.
  • Fluent professional English.
  • Ability to work within European business hours.

Nice to have:

  • Prior Head of Risk, VP Risk, or CRO title at a regulated fintech, EMI, PSP, or crypto company.
  • DORA Register of Information preparation experience.
  • FCA operational resilience framework experience.
  • MiCA post-authorization obligations: capital adequacy reporting, CASP risk framework.
  • Experience building a risk function from scratch or taking an early framework to maturity.
  • Third-party/vendor risk management at scale.
  • Capital adequacy and safeguarding design for an EMI or PI application.
  • Travel Rule risk implementation across multiple jurisdictions.
  • FRM (GARP), PRM, or equivalent qualification.
  • Russian language skills.

We Offer

Location: Remote-first (Baltics preferred), with periodic in-person time at the Riga office.

Contract: Employment contract in Latvia, B2B elsewhere.

Compensation: Up to €10,000 gross/month (based on experience) + performance-based bonus linked to OKRs.

Other benefits: Medical insurance, L&D budget, English classes, and regular team-building activities.

Why Join?

  • Report directly to the CEO: your risk view shapes company decisions; it does not just support them.
  • Own a DORA workstream and lead both EMI risk frameworks from day one.
  • Strong regulatory portfolio: EU authorizations in place and further license applications in the pipeline.
  • Build one unified fraud risk framework across retail, B2B infrastructure, on-ramp, and custody.
  • Self-funded, stable company with no investor pressure shaping risk decisions.
  • High autonomy and minimal micromanagement.

With our proprietary 3D visualization technology, our worldwide network of designers empowered with AI tools, and our revolutionary customer-facing AI design assistant, we're at the inflection point of a massive market transformation. This isn't just another operations role, it's the opportunity to build the category-defining business at the intersection of AI, design, and commerce.

Our Core Values

Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive Trade Sales & Enablement Manager based in LATAM to drive the day-to-day execution behind Havenly’s fast-growing trade business. You will turn trade strategy and analysis into shipped work, put a prioritized book in front of our inside and outside sales reps, and push them to work it. You will partner closely with U.S.-based sales, marketing, CX, supply chain, and RevOps through both real-time collaboration and strong async execution.

You own the execution and the feedback loop, leaning on tooling, dashboards, and triggered alerts rather than manual follow-up. You will move the metrics that matter most: application-to-order conversion, repeat rate, cross-brand shopping, and active-account growth.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Execution & Rep Enablement

  • Own the routing logic behind rep books across inside (retail) and outside sales: prioritization, assignment, reassignment, and firm-linking

Trade Program Operations

  • Manage tier-progression mechanics and verify delivery of earned perks and benefits

  • Feed what you learn on the ground back to marketing and sales leadership

Campaigns & Lifecycle

  • Write, QA, and iterate on trade sequences across acquisition, onboarding, and re-engagement
  • Keep messaging on-brand and consistent
  • Test and optimize to lift conversion, repeat, and cross-brand rates

CRM, Reporting & Analytics

  • Handle day-to-day trade CRM and HubSpot administration and data integrity, working with our HubSpot Admin
  • Build self-serve dashboards and automated alerts covering application health, application-to-order conversion, and tier movement
  • Surface leading indicators like primed leads, idle accounts, stalled deals, and tier gaps
  • Deliver clear recommendations on book structure, engagement volume, sales activities, and deal management

CX & Supply Chain Partnership

  • Act as the single point of contact for trade across CX and Supply Chain
  • Define escalation steps and expected response times
  • Find and unblock stuck orders before delivery friction costs us accounts we have already won

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in B2B, trade, or wholesale sales operations and enablement
  • CRM administration and reporting experience (HubSpot strongly preferred), plus experience building automated outreach sequences and lifecycle campaigns
  • Proven experience working remotely with U.S.-based teams
  • Strong English communication skills, written and verbal
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in an async environment
  • Strong analytical skills, including building funnel reporting and turning findings into a prioritized plan of action
  • Experience driving a sales team to a number without managing it directly
  • Clean, on-brand customer-facing writing, and the ability to QA someone else’s
  • Comfort working cross-functionally and owning an escalation process other teams depend on
  • Bonus: experience with loyalty or membership programs, multi-brand or marketplace retail, or CX and supply chain escalation design
  • We are building with AI as part of how we work. We are looking for people who are curious about AI-assisted tools and eager to adopt them.

Success Metrics

  • Application-to-first-order conversion (approved applicants who order within 90 days)
  • 90-day repeat rate and 12-month trade LTV
  • Tier progression rate
  • Cross-brand shopping, total trade revenue, and active-account growth
  • Fast, reliable response times to requests from sales, CX, and supply chain

What We’re Looking For

  • Highly responsive and dependable during U.S. working hours overlap
  • Self-starter who does not need step-by-step direction
  • Clear communicator who keeps stakeholders informed without being asked
  • Builder and automator who reaches for tooling and triggers before manual follow-up
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting prioritiess

The Details

  • Location: Latin America: Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay, Mexico, Costa Rica

This role provides hands-on leadership across application development, platform operations, and production support while partnering with Product Owners, engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders. SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES

  • Advanced knowledge of Palantir Foundry and its core platform capabilities.

  • Experience designing data pipelines, integrations, and application workflows.

  • Ability to lead technical discussions, influence engineering decisions, and mentor team members.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred: Strong background in the following areas:

Job Description:

Position Summary

RxSafe / Eyecon is seeking a motivated, results-driven Inside Sales Representative to expand the use of Eyecon pharmacy counting and verification technology and create new opportunities for the broader RxSafe portfolio. This position will spend the majority of its time proactively calling and emailing pharmacies, following up on inbound and marketing leads, conducting virtual discovery and product presentations, and moving qualified Eyecon opportunities through the sales process.


Eyecon is purpose-built for pharmacy workflow and helps pharmacies improve prescription counting accuracy, efficiency, and documentation through visual counting and verification technology. The Inside Sales Representative will become a product expert who can clearly connect Eyecon's capabilities to the day-to-day challenges faced by pharmacy owners, pharmacists, technicians, and managers.


In addition to selling Eyecon, this role will identify pharmacy needs that may be a fit for RxSafe automation solutions, qualify those opportunities, and generate high-quality leads for the RxSafe sales team. This is a fully remote position with no routine customer visits. Success requires a self-starter who is highly organized, persistent, comfortable working independently, and able to create structure and momentum in a remote environment.


About RxSafe / Eyecon

RxSafe provides pharmacy automation and technology solutions designed to help pharmacies improve accuracy, safety, efficiency, workflow, and medication adherence. The product portfolio includes Eyecon visual counting and verification solutions along with RxSafe pharmacy automation systems. This role is an important front-line position for introducing pharmacies to our technology, growing Eyecon sales, and creating new opportunities across the RxSafe portfolio.


Key Responsibilities

Eyecon Sales

  • Own the inside sales process for Eyecon opportunities, from initial prospecting and qualification through virtual presentation, quoting, follow-up, negotiation, and close.
  • Conduct high-volume outbound calls and targeted email outreach to independent, community, and other pharmacy prospects.
  • Follow up quickly and consistently on inbound leads, marketing campaigns, trade-show leads, and other sales inquiries.
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand prescription volume, current counting processes, workflow challenges, business needs, purchasing requirements, and decision-makers.
  • Present and demonstrate Eyecon virtually, clearly communicating its value in pharmacy accuracy, efficiency, workflow, visual verification, and documentation.
  • Develop quotes, manage follow-up, address objections, and advance qualified opportunities through the sales pipeline.
  • Achieve established Eyecon revenue, activity, pipeline, and customer acquisition goals.
    •

RxSafe Lead Generation

  • Identify customer needs and workflow challenges that may be a fit for RxSafe pharmacy automation solutions.
  • Introduce the broader RxSafe product portfolio at a high level and create interest in relevant solutions.
  • Qualify, document, and hand off high-quality RxSafe opportunities to the appropriate sales representative.
  • Coordinate with the RxSafe sales team to ensure effective lead handoff, follow-up, and visibility into opportunity progression.

Prospecting, Pipeline & CRM Management

  • Research and identify prospective pharmacy customers within assigned markets and target segments.
  • Maintain a disciplined cadence of phone, email, and virtual follow-up activity.
  • Build and manage an organized sales pipeline, prioritizing opportunities based on fit, urgency, and likelihood to close.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of contacts, activities, opportunities, next steps, and lead progression within the CRM and company systems.
  • Partner with marketing and sales leadership on targeted campaigns, lead follow-up strategies, and new business development initiatives.

Customer & Team Collaboration

  • Build credibility and strong relationships with pharmacy owners, pharmacists, technicians, managers, and other decision-makers.
  • Respond professionally and confidently to product questions, objections, competitive considerations, and customer concerns.
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, technical, implementation, and customer service teams to provide an effective customer experience.
  • Participate in ongoing sales training, coaching, product education, and team development activities.

Travel & Trade Shows

  • Represent RxSafe / Eyecon at approximately five pharmacy industry trade shows per year.
  • Engage attendees, demonstrate products, capture and qualify leads, and execute timely post-show follow-up.
  • No routine customer-site visits are required; customer interactions are primarily conducted by phone, email, and virtual meetings.

Estimated Travel: Approximately five trade shows annually, plus occasional company meetings or training.


Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong phone presence and confidence initiating outbound sales conversations.
  • Ability to quickly build rapport and establish credibility with pharmacy professionals and business owners.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and disciplined, with the ability to thrive in a fully remote work environment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Persistence, resilience, and comfort with high-volume prospecting and rejection.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with consistent follow-through.
  • Comfort learning, explaining, and virtually demonstrating technology-based products.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to consistently use CRM and sales engagement tools.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Sales, Marketing, Business, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in inside sales, business development, lead generation, telemarketing, or customer-facing sales.
  • Experience working in a pharmacy, including pharmacy technician, pharmacy operations, or another pharmacy-related role.
  • Experience working in healthcare, medical, pharmaceutical, medical device, or another related field.
  • Experience selling technology, pharmacy solutions, medical products, or capital equipment.
  • Experience using CRM platforms and sales engagement tools.

• Spanish fluency is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently achieves outbound call, email, and prospecting activity goals.
  • Meets or exceeds Eyecon sales revenue goals.
  • Creates a consistent flow of qualified RxSafe opportunities for the broader sales team.
  • Maintains an accurate, organized, and actively managed sales pipeline.
  • Develops strong knowledge of Eyecon and enough knowledge of the RxSafe portfolio to recognize and create additional opportunities.
  • Works independently, follows through on commitments, and remains productive and accountable in a remote environment.
  • Demonstrates a positive, competitive, persistent, and growth-oriented mindset.

Physical Requirements/Working Conditions (if applicable)

This position is primarily home-office based and requires regular use of a computer, telephone, video conferencing, and other standard office equipment.

JOB SUMMARY:

Provides senior level support for complex analysis and investigations to identify, assess, and mitigate insider risks affecting Molina Healthcare’s employees, members, operations, systems, data, and reputation. This role integrates technical and behavioral information, advises leaders and cross-functional partners, and advances monitoring, investigative, reporting, and risk-reduction capabilities to strengthen the Insider Threat Program.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:

  • Leads the identification, triage, analysis, and investigation of insider threat indicators and anomalous activity to enable timely, defensible risk decisions.
  • Analyzes and correlates complex technical and non-technical information from user activity monitoring, user and entity behavior analytics, data loss prevention, insider risk management, security information and event management, endpoint telemetry, Human Resources information, and other enterprise sources.
  • Conducts proactive threat hunting and develops hypotheses, timelines, link analyses, behavior profiles, and threat assessments to identify emerging risks before incidents occur.
  • Leads complex insider threat inquiries and investigations from initiation through closure, including interviews, evidence gathering, case documentation, risk assessments, executive summaries, and recommendations.
  • Presents findings and mitigation strategies to leaders and program stakeholders and ensures investigations follow applicable policies, privacy requirements, legal obligations, and ethical standards.
  • Develops and enhances detection use cases, investigative methodologies, operating procedures, dashboards, metrics, and performance reporting to improve program effectiveness.
  • Identifies monitoring, detection, reporting, and investigative gaps and supports implementation and optimization of analytical technologies, automation, and other program capabilities.
  • Contributes to policies, standards, procedures, awareness materials, audits, assessments, tabletop exercises, and maturity initiatives that strengthen insider risk management.
  • Partners with Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Information Security, Corporate Security, Internal Audit, and business leadership on cross-functional investigations and risk mitigation.
  • Communicates complex insider risk issues to technical and non-technical audiences and provides subject matter guidance, training, and awareness to promote reporting and reduce risk.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • At least 5 years of experience in insider threat, counterintelligence, digital forensics, intelligence analysis, corporate investigations, cyber threat intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Experience leading investigations involving technical and behavioral indicators and preparing executive-level reports and briefings.
  • Experience analyzing information from data loss prevention, user and entity behavior analytics, security information and event management, endpoint detection and response, insider risk management, user activity monitoring, email security, or comparable security platforms.
  • Advanced knowledge of insider threat methods, investigative techniques, risk management principles, cybersecurity concepts, data protection controls, security operations, and privacy and compliance considerations related to employee monitoring.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, written, verbal, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to analyze large volumes of information, develop actionable conclusions, communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, and handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Global Counter-Insider Threat Professional, Certified Insider Threat Analyst, Certified Insider Threat Program Manager, or comparable credentials.

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Organizational Transformation

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Compensation

57,100.00 - 107,200.00 CAD Annual


Purpose

The Sales Solution Specialist responsible for helping the customer succeed while achieving specific team and individual sales and profit goals set by the company. Provide an exceptional level of business to business (B2B) sales consultation, account management, customer service, and innovative solutions that differentiate Sysco in the marketplace. This role is responsible for the account management and growth of Healthcare & Senior Living independent customer sales with a territory size of approximately 75 Accounts and $18 million.


Responsibilities

  • Accountable for Business Development for independent Healthcare (HC) & Senior Living (SL) customers in the local and surrounding area.
  • Add product lines to existing customers by identifying opportunities and incorporate team selling activities.
  • Develops and delivers sales bids/proposals/presentations and conducts product demonstrations with key decision makers.
  • Executes National Sales Team strategy and collaborates on opportunities to obtain new lines and recover lost lines of business.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve customer account profitability.
  • Manages accurate sales pipeline, consultative activities, and customer contact information in customer relationship management (CRM) tool.
  • Supports quarterly business reviews with local customer headquarters to discuss joint opportunities to grow sales and improve profitability.
  • Ensures customer contract compliance and define action plans to align to master service agreement (MSA) representations.
  • Provides consultative services by providing market trends and insights, identifying integration points with Specialty Companies (Fresh Point, European Imports, SOTF, Buckhead).
  • Engages the Customer Experience Team to escalate all customer issues.
  • Coordinates and leads all activities and resources for targeted accounts and ensures follow-up on all next step agreements.
  • Understands our customers’ business and provides value-added solutions through products, services, tools, and information to help them succeed. Provides education, promotes offerings, and leverages these resources to drive business growth with targeted accounts.
  • Establishes positive working relationships with all departments in the Region.
  • Utilizes CRM tools (Sysco 360) as communication and measurement tool.
  • Complies with Sysco’s Food Safety Policy and procedures to ensure food safety, quality and legality requirements are met.
  • Is willing to work safely with minimal environmental impact and understands the importance of reporting all hazards, incidents, and environmental spills immediately to their supervisor.
  • Understands that they play an integral role in their own safety and that of their colleagues and is willing to speak out when hazards are present.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Skills

  • This role requires full bilingual proficiency in both French and English to communicate with internal and external customers.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook.
  • Professional salesperson with proven ability to cultivate relationships and grow sales.
  • Strong financial acumen and ability to properly plan and execute business plans.
  • Demonstrated skills in consultative selling, networking and negotiations.
  • Business and restaurant operations acumen to manage sophisticated customers.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work with and influence a variety of key stakeholders.
  • Ability to express information in terms of profit and loss, food cost and expense ratio.
  • Persuasive communication skills, ability to effectively communicate with internal and external teams.
  • Demonstrate a high level of business acumen and interpersonal savvy.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, including the ability to execute multiple initiatives at the same time.
  • Ability to learn the use of proprietary CRM tools for planning and forecasting sales growth.
  • Solid analytical problem-solving skills, including familiarity with analyzing reports and deriving insights from data.
  • Proactive, self-directed, with the ability to structure a weekly schedule to be successful.

Education

  • Post-Secondary Degree or Diploma in a business-related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

Experience

  • 2 years or more of sales experience required.

Travel Requirements

  • There will be travel required. A valid driver’s license in good standing with access to a vehicle is required.

Rémunération

57 100 $ à 107 200 $ CAD par année


Objectif du poste

Le ou la spécialiste des solutions de vente est responsable d’aider les clients à atteindre leurs objectifs de réussite tout en réalisant les objectifs individuels et d’équipe en matière de ventes et de rentabilité établis par l’entreprise. La personne titulaire du poste offre un niveau exceptionnel de consultation en vente interentreprises (B2B), de gestion de comptes, de service à la clientèle et de solutions novatrices qui permettent à Sysco de se démarquer sur le marché.

Ce poste est responsable de la gestion et de la croissance des ventes auprès de clients indépendants du secteur des soins de santé et des résidences pour personnes âgées, sur un territoire comptant environ 75 comptes et représentant 18 millions de dollars.


Responsabilités

  • Assurer le développement des affaires auprès des clients indépendants des secteurs des soins de santé (SC) et des résidences pour personnes âgées (RPA) dans la région locale et les environs.
  • Ajouter des gammes de produits aux comptes existants en repérant les occasions d’affaires et en intégrant des activités de vente en équipe.
  • Élaborer et présenter des soumissions, des propositions et des présentations de vente, et effectuer des démonstrations de produits auprès des principaux décideurs.
  • Mettre en œuvre la stratégie de l’équipe nationale des ventes et collaborer sur les occasions d’affaires afin d’obtenir de nouvelles gammes de produits et de récupérer des secteurs d’activité perdus.
  • Repérer les occasions d’améliorer la rentabilité des comptes clients.
  • Assurer la gestion d’un pipeline de ventes précis ainsi que des activités de consultation et des coordonnées des clients dans l’outil de gestion de la relation client (CRM).
  • Participer aux revues d’affaires trimestrielles avec les sièges sociaux des clients locaux afin de discuter des occasions conjointes d’accroître les ventes et d’améliorer la rentabilité.
  • Veiller au respect des contrats clients et définir des plans d’action afin d’assurer la conformité aux dispositions de l’entente-cadre de services (MSA).
  • Fournir des services-conseils en présentant les tendances et les perspectives du marché et en repérant les possibilités d’intégration avec les entreprises spécialisées (FreshPoint, European Imports, SOTF, Buckhead).
  • Faire appel à l’équipe Expérience client afin d’assurer le suivi et l’escalade de tous les problèmes soulevés par les clients.
  • Coordonner et diriger toutes les activités et ressources liées aux comptes ciblés et assurer le suivi de toutes les ententes concernant les prochaines étapes.
  • Comprendre les activités de nos clients et leur proposer des solutions à valeur ajoutée au moyen de produits, de services, d’outils et d’information afin de les aider à réussir. Offrir de la formation, promouvoir les offres et tirer parti de ces ressources pour stimuler la croissance des affaires auprès des comptes ciblés.
  • Établir des relations de travail positives avec tous les services de la région.
  • Utiliser les outils CRM (Sysco 360) comme outils de communication et de mesure.
  • Respecter la politique et les procédures de Sysco en matière de salubrité des aliments afin de garantir le respect des exigences relatives à la salubrité, à la qualité et à la conformité réglementaire des aliments.
  • Travailler de façon sécuritaire en réduisant au minimum les répercussions sur l’environnement et comprendre l’importance de signaler immédiatement à son superviseur tout danger, incident ou déversement environnemental.
  • Comprendre son rôle essentiel dans sa propre sécurité et celle de ses collègues et être disposé à intervenir lorsque des situations dangereuses sont présentes.
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe qui lui est confiée.

Compétences

  • Ce poste requiert un bilinguisme complet en français et en anglais afin de communiquer efficacement avec la clientèle interne et externe.
  • Niveau intermédiaire dans l’utilisation de Microsoft Office, notamment Excel, Word, PowerPoint et Outlook.
  • Professionnel(le) de la vente ayant fait ses preuves dans l’établissement de relations et la croissance des ventes.
  • Solide sens des affaires financières et capacité à planifier et à exécuter efficacement des plans d’affaires.
  • Compétences démontrées en vente consultative, en réseautage et en négociation.
  • Bonne connaissance des activités commerciales et de restauration permettant de gérer des clients ayant des besoins complexes.
  • Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et capacité à collaborer avec divers intervenants clés et à exercer une influence auprès de ceux-ci.
  • Capacité à présenter l’information en fonction des profits et pertes, du coût des aliments et des ratios de dépenses.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication persuasive et capacité à communiquer efficacement avec les équipes internes et externes.
  • Faire preuve d’un haut niveau de sens des affaires et d’une grande aisance dans les relations interpersonnelles.
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et en gestion de projets, notamment la capacité à gérer et à exécuter plusieurs initiatives simultanément.
  • Capacité à apprendre et à utiliser des outils CRM exclusifs pour planifier et prévoir la croissance des ventes.
  • Solides compétences analytiques et en résolution de problèmes, notamment une bonne connaissance de l’analyse de rapports et de la capacité à tirer des conclusions pertinentes à partir de données.
  • Être proactif(ve), autonome et capable de structurer son horaire hebdomadaire afin d’atteindre ses objectifs.

Formation

  • Diplôme d’études postsecondaires ou diplôme dans un domaine lié aux affaires; une expérience équivalente peut être considérée.

Expérience

  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience en vente requis.

Exigences relatives aux déplacements

  • Des déplacements sont requis dans le cadre du poste. Un permis de conduire valide et en règle, ainsi qu’un accès à un véhicule, sont requis.

Sysco is committed to Employment Equity. Accommodations during the recruitment process are available upon request for candidates with disabilities.

At Sysco, we aspire to create a global culture that is decidedly diverse, equitable, and inclusive – one where we foster belonging as we care for one another and connect the world through food and trusted partnerships. We are Better Together.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Sysco is the global leader in foodservice distribution. With over 71,000 colleagues and a fleet of over 13,000 vehicles, Sysco operates approximately 333 distribution facilities worldwide and serves more than 700,000 customer locations. We offer our colleagues the opportunity to grow personally and professionally, to contribute to the success of a dynamic organization, and to serve others in a manner that exceeds their expectations. We’re looking for talented, hard-working individuals to join our team. Come grow with us and let us show you why Sysco is at the heart of food and service.

Our Purpose: Connecting the world to share food and care for one another

Our Mission: Delivering success for our customers through industry-leading people, products and solutions

Our Identity: Together we define our future of foodservice and supply chain

Here’s a sample of the many benefits Sysco colleagues enjoy:

Comprehensive Flexible Benefits including Health and Dental, Health Care Spending and Wellness Accounts • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability • Life Insurance • Voluntary Optional Insurance • Parental Leave Plan • Company Pension Plan • Group RRSP & TFSA • Employee and Family Assistance • Stock Purchase Plan • Maple Virtual Care • Unlimited on-line learning • Sysco product discounts • Preferred vendor discounts • Associate Resource Groups

(*benefits may vary based on location or bargaining unit)

raw.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Provides senior level support for complex analysis and investigations to identify, assess, and mitigate insider risks affecting Molina Healthcare’s employees, members, operations, systems, data, and reputation. This role integrates technical and behavioral information, advises leaders and cross-functional partners, and advances monitoring, investigative, reporting, and risk-reduction capabilities to strengthen the Insider Threat Program.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:

  • Leads the identification, triage, analysis, and investigation of insider threat indicators and anomalous activity to enable timely, defensible risk decisions.
  • Analyzes and correlates complex technical and non-technical information from user activity monitoring, user and entity behavior analytics, data loss prevention, insider risk management, security information and event management, endpoint telemetry, Human Resources information, and other enterprise sources.
  • Conducts proactive threat hunting and develops hypotheses, timelines, link analyses, behavior profiles, and threat assessments to identify emerging risks before incidents occur.
  • Leads complex insider threat inquiries and investigations from initiation through closure, including interviews, evidence gathering, case documentation, risk assessments, executive summaries, and recommendations.
  • Presents findings and mitigation strategies to leaders and program stakeholders and ensures investigations follow applicable policies, privacy requirements, legal obligations, and ethical standards.
  • Develops and enhances detection use cases, investigative methodologies, operating procedures, dashboards, metrics, and performance reporting to improve program effectiveness.
  • Identifies monitoring, detection, reporting, and investigative gaps and supports implementation and optimization of analytical technologies, automation, and other program capabilities.
  • Contributes to policies, standards, procedures, awareness materials, audits, assessments, tabletop exercises, and maturity initiatives that strengthen insider risk management.
  • Partners with Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Information Security, Corporate Security, Internal Audit, and business leadership on cross-functional investigations and risk mitigation.
  • Communicates complex insider risk issues to technical and non-technical audiences and provides subject matter guidance, training, and awareness to promote reporting and reduce risk.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • At least 5 years of experience in insider threat, counterintelligence, digital forensics, intelligence analysis, corporate investigations, cyber threat intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Experience leading investigations involving technical and behavioral indicators and preparing executive-level reports and briefings.
  • Experience analyzing information from data loss prevention, user and entity behavior analytics, security information and event management, endpoint detection and response, insider risk management, user activity monitoring, email security, or comparable security platforms.
  • Advanced knowledge of insider threat methods, investigative techniques, risk management principles, cybersecurity concepts, data protection controls, security operations, and privacy and compliance considerations related to employee monitoring.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, written, verbal, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to analyze large volumes of information, develop actionable conclusions, communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, and handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Global Counter-Insider Threat Professional, Certified Insider Threat Analyst, Certified Insider Threat Program Manager, or comparable credentials.
  • Experience applying artificial intelligence, automation, and data analytics to improve investigative efficiency.
  • Experience with insider risk management, threat analytics, case management, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience in healthcare, another regulated industry, intelligence, military, law enforcement, or corporate investigations.

To all current Molina employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the Internal Job Board.
